callings.title: Vanguard & Bastions
callings.subtitle: Unyielding protectors & frontline stalwarts
callings.fantasy: Unyielding champions whose discipline and resolve turn sheer presence into an impenetrable wall. Whether standing firm against towering beasts or shielding allies from ruin, these archetypes embody grit, guardianship, and steadfast poise.

callings.title: Unbound Strikers
callings.subtitle: Relentless blades & arcane conduits
callings.fantasy: Relentless blades and arcane conduits who channel raw destructive momentum to shatter overwhelming foes. Built for adventurers who thrive on decisive poise, daring flair, and turning every opening into an unforgettable legend.

callings.title: Tacticians & Menders
callings.subtitle: Battlefield conductors & life-weavers
callings.fantasy: Battlefield conductors and life-weavers who reshape the rhythm of every journey through foresight, harmony, and restoration. Ideal for adventurers who love empowering their company, reading the flow of fate, and turning desperate moments into triumph.

souls.lore: A seasoned war-captain whose rallying cries and battlefield formations turn scattered adventurers into an ironclad company.
souls.summary: Active battlefield tactician (Lv. 10+): weaves short-cooldown party cries and enemy marks that grow stronger as you level, shares your single active Warrior stance through Warcry, and trades personal swing uptime for group-wide coordination.
souls.atAGlance: Commander is a frontline Warrior support Soul built around amplifying your party's offense and steadying the line when fights turn dangerous. You commit to one active Warrior stance at a time, project a specialized version of that stance to nearby allies with Warcry, mark priority targets with Tactical Breach to reward coordinated skillchains and Magic Bursts, and weave short-cooldown tactical cries for defense, TP efficiency, and emergency cleansing. You still fight on the frontline, but your true impact comes from elevating the entire group's rhythm.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Max HP, Attack, Accuracy, and Store TP as you level.
Early & Rapid Warcry (Lv. 10, 60s CD, 45s duration, 10y): Shares a specialized party version of your single active Warrior stance (Berserk, Defender, Aggressor, Retaliation, or Restraint).
Tactical Breach (Lv. 10, 20s CD, 10s, Enemy 15y): Marks a target so Skillchains, Magic Bursts, and Critical Hits deal substantially more damage, and awards bonus TP to the skillchain closer.
Formation: Bulwark (Lv. 10, 25s CD, 15s, Party 10y): Layers a stacking Phalanx ward alongside Magic Defense, Status Resistance, and Knockback Resistance that scale with level.
Battle Cadence (Lv. 10, 20s CD, 12s, Party 10y): Bolsters Subtle Blow, Conserve TP, and Cure Potency Received for nearby allies.

Rallying Horn (Lv. 10, 45s CD, 12s, Party 12y): Restores party HP and TP, grants temporary Movement Speed, and cleanses Slow/Bind (expanding to Weight/Paralysis at Lv. 30, DEF/MDEF Down at Lv. 50, and ATK/ACC Down at Lv. 70).

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Commander has no weapon lock. Choose any Warrior weapon that fits your preferred weapon skills and helps your party open or close skillchains.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Commander has no weapon lock. Choose any Warrior weapon that fits your preferred weapon skills and helps your party open or close skillchains.
souls.resourceSystem: Early & Rapid Warcry (Lv. 10, 60s CD, 45s duration, 10y): Shares a specialized party version of your single active Warrior stance (Berserk, Defender, Aggressor, Retaliation, or Restraint).
mechanics: Single-Stance Discipline: Commander cannot stack multiple Warrior stances at once. Choosing a new stance immediately replaces your previous one, and Warcry shares a tailored party effect based on whichever stance is active:
Berserk: Boosts party Attack.
Defender: Reinforces party Defense and mitigation.
Aggressor: Improves party Accuracy and Double Attack.
Retaliation: Enhances party Counter and Store TP.
Restraint: Strengthens party Weapon Skill Damage and TP Bonus.

souls.lore: A storm of untamed martial fury who surrenders caution to the roar of battle, cleaving through ranks with primal ferocity.
souls.summary: Unrelenting frontline fury (Lv. 10+): supercharges Berserk, Aggressor, Blood Rage, and Warcry with heavy Attack, Double Attack, and Weapon Skill Damage while trading defensive safety for explosive burst windows.
souls.atAGlance: Berserker is an all-out physical burst DPS Soul built around relentless aggression. It supercharges Warrior's classic offensive abilities—Berserk, Aggressor, Blood Rage, and Warcry—and layers Bloodlust Surge on top for explosive burst windows. Between weapon skills, Savage Cleave delivers a brutal close-range strike at the cost of your own health. You bring devastating melee pressure, but stacking Defense-lowering buffs and self-recoil leaves you exposed if you mistime your aggression.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Attack, Double Attack, Weapon Skill Damage, and Store TP as you level.
Bloodlust Surge (Lv. 10, 25s CD, 10s, Self): Delivers a major surge in Attack and Double Attack damage at the cost of reduced Defense.
Savage Cleave (Lv. 10, 20s CD, Enemy 4y): Overstraining close-range physical strike that grants zero TP and inflicts non-lethal HP self-recoil.
Berserk: Grants stronger Attack potency, extends duration by 60s, and awards an immediate burst of TP on activation.
Aggressor: Removes its usual Evasion penalty and grants bonus Critical Hit Rate.
Blood Rage: Grants extra Critical Hit Rate and extends duration by 15s.
Warcry: Delivers amplified Attack potency.

weaponConfig.summary: Extended template supporting dual Great Axe wielding (scheduled in Extended Soul Weapon Templates).

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Berserker has no weapon lock. Great Axe, Axe, dual Axes, or Sword setups all work well—pick the weapon family that matches your gear and unlocked weapon-skill talents.
souls.resourceSystem: Enhanced Berserk: Grants stronger Attack than standard Berserk, lasts an extra 60 seconds, and awards an immediate burst of TP upon activation.
mechanics: Enhanced Berserk: Grants stronger Attack than standard Berserk, lasts an extra 60 seconds, and awards an immediate burst of TP upon activation.
Enhanced Aggressor: Drops its usual Evasion penalty and adds bonus Critical Hit Rate.
Enhanced Blood Rage & Warcry: Blood Rage gains extra Critical Hit Rate and an additional 15 seconds of duration; Warcry delivers stronger Attack potency.

Bloodlust Surge: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (25s recast, 10s duration, Self). Substantially boosts Attack and Double Attack damage while lowering your Defense. Its offensive power grows stronger as you level.

Savage Cleave: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (20s recast, 4y enemy range). Unleashes an overstraining physical cleave scaled by your weapon and Strength. Grants zero TP and inflicts non-lethal HP recoil that scales with level (cannot drop you below 1 HP).
Passive Growth: As you level, Berserker passively strengthens Attack, Double Attack, Weapon Skill Damage, and Store TP.

souls.lore: An unbroken spear-and-buckler stalwart forged in the discipline of the ancient phalanx, holding the line where lesser shields shatter.
souls.summary: Frontline phalanx tank (Lv. 10+): requires a Polearm paired with a Size-1 Buckler (or an empty Sub slot for a virtual Aspis Buckler) to unlock Spear-Wall Guard/Block, Spartan's Grit damage-to-barrier conversion, and charge-based Melee and Spell Brace deflection.
souls.atAGlance: Spartan is a Polearm-and-Buckler frontline tank that turns incoming pressure into Grit, then cashes that Grit out through Polearm weapon skills for sturdy Iron Resolve Stoneskin barriers. You pair steady shield defense with active next-hit deflection: Defender arms a Light Brace, while Phalanx Ward spends Grit to arm a devastating Heavy Brace. Mastering Spartan means reading boss tells, timing your Braces for the hits that truly matter, and cycling Grit into fresh barriers before spikes land.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Max HP, VIT, Defense, Shield Defense, Damage Taken reduction, Enmity, and Enmity Retention as you level.

Phalanx Spear & Buckler Mastery: Grants scaling Polearm and Shield skill, Block Rate, and Shield TP. A real Size-1 Buckler provides superior Block Rate and a higher Iron Resolve barrier cap than the virtual Aspis Buckler.
Spartan's Grit: Taking damage or blocking grants +1 Grit (max 5). Any Polearm weapon skill consumes all Grit for a 30s Iron Resolve Stoneskin barrier, heavy enmity, and Maim.
Impaling Thrust (Lv. 10, 20s CD, Enemy 8y, Polearm): High-enmity strike that Stuns for 2s (plus 5s Silence mid-cast), applies Maim for 15s, and grants +2 Grit (+4 during Defender or Mighty Strikes).
Phalanx Ward (Lv. 10, 35s CD, 2 Grit, Self 12s, Polearm): Boosts Block Rate, Damage Taken reduction, Enmity, and Knockback Immunity, and arms 1 Heavy Brace.

Spear-Wall Brace: Defender (15s CD) arms a 10s Light Brace (reduces next hit, +1 Grit, Off-Balance). Heavy Brace sharply blunts the next hit, maxes Grit to 5, inflicts a 2s Stun and Exposed Guard, and adds 4s Silence vs. spells.
Tactical Instinct: Warns you when your target approaches a weaponskill or begins casting.

Tank Tradeoff & WAR Abilities: Trades personal damage output for frontline resilience; Warcry reduces incoming party damage, Provoke and Warcry trigger Adrenaline Surge below half HP, and Mighty Strikes adds strong mitigation, Enmity, and instant 5 Grit.

weaponConfig.summary: Extended template supporting Polearm paired with a Size-1 Buckler (scheduled in Extended Soul Weapon Templates).

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Stats: Prioritize Max HP, VIT, Defense, Shield/Block skill, Damage Taken reduction, and Enmity. Keep enough Polearm Accuracy to land weapon skills reliably when you need to convert Grit into a barrier.
souls.resourceSystem: Spartan's Grit: Taking damage or blocking grants +1 Grit (max 5). Any Polearm weapon skill consumes all Grit for a 30s Iron Resolve Stoneskin barrier, heavy enmity, and Maim.
mechanics: Phalanx Spear & Buckler Mastery: Requires a Polearm paired with either a Size-1 Buckler or an empty Sub slot (virtual Aspis Buckler). Grants scaling Polearm and Shield skill, Block Rate, and Shield TP, with a real Size-1 Buckler providing superior block rate and a higher Iron Resolve barrier cap.

Spartan's Grit (Max 5): Built by taking hits, blocking, landing Impaling Thrust (+2 Grit, or +4 during Defender or Mighty Strikes), deflecting with Light Brace (+1 Grit), or popping Mighty Strikes (instant 5 Grit).

Iron Resolve: Any Polearm weapon skill consumes all Grit stacks to wrap you in a 30-second Stoneskin barrier, apply Maim (lowering enemy Attack and Accuracy), and generate heavy enmity. Barrier potency per stack grows as you level.
Defender & Light Brace: 15s recast. Arms a 10-second Light Brace that blunts the next qualifying hit, adds 1 Grit, and leaves the attacker Off-Balance.

Phalanx Ward & Heavy Brace: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (35s recast, costs 2 Grit, 12s duration, requires Polearm). Boosts Block Rate, Damage Taken reduction, Enmity, and Knockback Immunity, and arms 1 Heavy Brace that sharply reduces the next hit, fills Grit to 5, inflicts a 2s Stun and Exposed Guard, and adds a 4s Silence against spells.

Impaling Thrust: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (20s recast, 8y range, requires Polearm). High-enmity spear strike that Stuns for 2s (plus 5s Silence if interrupting a cast), inflicts Maim for 15s, and generates Grit.

souls.lore: A serene master of the quarterstaff and martial stillness who turns an opponent’s own momentum into poise and unshakable footing.
souls.summary: Agile Staff evasion and counter tank (Lv. 10+): evades and parries incoming blows with a Staff, automatically ripostes missed or parried strikes for HP, TP, and enmity, and anchors threat through Iron Counterstance.
souls.atAGlance: Sensei is an agile Staff evasion and counter tank that turns missed and parried blows into relentless momentum. Armed with a Staff, every successful parry or evasion triggers Staff Riposte, restoring your HP and TP, building enmity, and striking back automatically. By removing Counterstance's traditional Defense penalty through Iron Counterstance and pairing it with enhanced Monk survival abilities, Sensei anchors the frontline through fluid deflection rather than raw armor alone.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Staff skill, Accuracy, Evasion, AGI, Parry, Counter, Counter Damage, Enmity, Enmity Retention, Max HP, and Damage Taken reduction as you level.
Staff Riposte (requires Staff): Boosts Parry Rate; parrying or evading an attack restores a small portion of Max HP, grants bonus TP and Enmity, and triggers a retaliatory strike or Evasive Counter.
Iron Counterstance (Lv. 10, 120s CD): Greatly increases Counter Rate, Counter Damage, Damage Taken reduction, and Enmity with zero Defense penalty.

Tank-Tuned Monk Abilities: Dodge (60s CD) boosts Evasion, Parry, Enmity, and Evasive Counter damage; Focus boosts Counter and Parry; Boost adds TP and Enmity; Chi Blast builds heavy Enmity with 30s Accuracy Down; Perfect Counter (45s CD) amplifies Counter Damage, Enmity, and self-healing; Chakra enhances healing, adds Regen, and cleanses Slow/Silence; Mantra grants party mitigation; Inner Strength (60s) provides major mitigation, Evasion, Counter Damage, and Enmity.

weaponConfig.summary: Required weapon: Keep a Staff equipped in your Main slot at all times. Your signature Parry bonus and Staff Riposte mechanics depend on wielding a Staff—do not revert to Hand-to-Hand.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Required weapon: Keep a Staff equipped in your Main slot at all times. Your signature Parry bonus and Staff Riposte mechanics depend on wielding a Staff—do not revert to Hand-to-Hand.
souls.resourceSystem: Iron Counterstance (Lv. 10, 120s CD): Greatly increases Counter Rate, Counter Damage, Damage Taken reduction, and Enmity with zero Defense penalty.
mechanics: Staff Riposte (Sensei's Flow): Requires a Staff in your Main slot. Passively improves your Parry Rate. Parrying an attack restores a small portion of Max HP, grants bonus TP and enmity, and strikes back; evading an attack restores HP and TP, builds enmity, and triggers an Evasive Counter (further empowered while Dodge is active).

Iron Counterstance: Unlocked early at Lv. 10 (120s recast, Self). Greatly boosts Counter Rate, Counter Damage, Damage Taken reduction, and Enmity while completely removing standard Counterstance's Defense penalty.
Tank-Tuned Monk Abilities:
Dodge (60s recast): Raises Evasion, Parry Rate, Enmity, and Evasive Counter damage.
Focus: Boosts Counter Rate, Parry, and Counter Damage.
Boost: Grants bonus TP and Enmity.

souls.lore: An empty-handed mystic who draws luminous life-force from within, guiding soothing currents of chi across the fray.
souls.summary: Bare-handed Light Chi channeler (Lv. 10+): fights with empty Main and Sub slots, firing dual 20y Light Chi bolts and ranged Hand-to-Hand weapon skills that stack Boost up to 100 for rapid 5s-recast Chi Blast 20y party heals and cleanses.
souls.atAGlance: Stillwater is an unarmed, ranged Light Chi healer that fights completely bare-handed from up to 20 yalms away. Every auto-attack fires dual Light Chi bolts that emit a 12-yalm AoE healing pulse around your target while building up to 100 Boost stacks. Chi Blast transforms from a damage skill into a rapid 5-second recast 20-yalm party AoE heal and debuff cleanse fueled by your Boost pool. You balance two healing anchors—your target for continuous combat pulses and yourself for emergency party rescues—all without relying on MP.
highlights: Empty-Handed Vow: Both Main and Sub slots must remain completely empty (bare fists only).

Dual-Fist Chi & Boost Stacking (0–20y): Auto-attacks unleash main and off-hand Light Chi bolts (plus Kick procs) and ranged H2H weapon skills up to 20y. Every landed bolt grants +1 Boost stack (weapon skills grant +3, +4, or +5 by TP tier, max 100) and emits a 12y healing pulse around the target; every 5 Boost stacks passively strengthen Cure Potency, Magic Accuracy, and Magic Attack Bonus.
Healer Offense Tradeoff: Trades away offensive melee and weapon-skill damage in exchange for continuous, MP-free party sustain.
Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Max HP, Regen, MND, VIT, Cure Potency, Hand-to-Hand skill, Magic Accuracy, Magic Attack Bonus, Enmity reduction, and Damage Taken reduction as you level.

Custom Abilities (Lv. 10+): Resonant Chi (20s CD, 20y Light burst with amplified target AoE heal, debuff cleanse, and bonus TP), Tranquil Lotus (30s CD, 12y party/Trust/pet heal plus 15s Sanctuary with Regen, Cure Received, and reduced Enmity), and Inner Harmony (45s CD, 18s meditative overdrive amplifying Cure Potency, MAB/MACC, Ability Haste, Regen, and Chi Bolt/Pulse power).

Healer Monk Abilities: Chi Blast (5s CD, 0 damage, 20y party AoE) consumes all Boost stacks for a massive party heal and up to 3 debuff cleanses (at 25, 50, and 80 stacks); Boost adds +5 stacks, bonus TP, and a pulse; Focus boosts MACC, MAB, and Cure Potency; Dodge adds Evasion, mitigation, and Enmity reduction; Chakra projects an AoE heal and self-cleanse; Mantra adds party Regen and Cure Received; Formless Strikes and Hundred Fists accelerate and empower Chi bolts and pulses.

weaponConfig.summary: Empty-Handed Vow: Both your Main and Sub slots must remain completely empty (bare fists only). Equipping any weapon or off-hand item disables your ranged Chi bolts and pulses.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Empty-Handed Vow: Both your Main and Sub slots must remain completely empty (bare fists only). Equipping any weapon or off-hand item disables your ranged Chi bolts and pulses.
souls.resourceSystem: Dual-Fist Chi & Boost Stacking (0–20y): Auto-attacks unleash main and off-hand Light Chi bolts (plus Kick procs) and ranged H2H weapon skills up to 20y. Every landed bolt grants +1 Boost stack (weapon skills grant +3, +4, or +5 by TP tier, max 100) and emits a 12y healing pulse around the target; every 5 Boost stacks passively strengthen Cure Potency, Magic Accuracy, and Magic Attack Bonus.
mechanics: Empty-Handed Vow: Strictly forbids equipping any weapon or item in Main or Sub slots.

Boost Pool (0–100 Stacks, 180s duration): Built by Light Chi bolts (+1), Boost (+5), and ranged Hand-to-Hand weapon skills (+3, +4, or +5 by TP tier). Every 5 Boost stacks passively increases Cure Potency, Magic Accuracy, and Magic Attack Bonus.
Chi Blast (Healer Form): 5s recast, 0 damage, 20y party AoE. Consumes all current Boost stacks for massive party healing and cleanses up to 3 debuffs (thresholds at 25, 50, and 80 stacks).
Two Healing Centers: Auto-attack bolts, ranged weapon skills, and Resonant Chi pulse around the enemy (12y radius). Tranquil Lotus (12y) and Chi Blast (20y) cover your allies directly.
Resonant Chi: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (20s recast, 20y enemy range). Fires a Light Chi burst that triggers an empowered AoE healing pulse and debuff cleanse around the target and grants bonus TP.

Tranquil Lotus: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (30s recast, 12y party/Trust/pet AoE). Restores HP scaled with Max HP and MND, then applies a 15-second Sanctuary granting Regen, Cure Potency Received, and reduced Enmity.

souls.lore: A living instrument of disciplined fist and foot, channeling lifelong temple training into a seamless tempest of strikes.
souls.summary: Pure Hand-to-Hand striker (Lv. 10+): bound strictly to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists, trading weapon versatility for relentless Kick Attacks, Double Attack, Critical Hits, Weapon Skill Damage, and rapid TP cycling.
souls.atAGlance: Wayfarer is a pure Hand-to-Hand martial DPS Soul devoted to relentless physical pressure. Bound to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists, you trade away weapon versatility for blistering Kick Attacks, Double Attack, Critical Hits, Weapon Skill Damage, and nonstop TP flow. Combo Momentum refunds a burst of TP every time you land a Hand-to-Hand weapon skill, turning sustained brawling into rapid-fire skillchain cycles.
highlights: H2H Oath: Strictly restricted to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists; non-H2H items in Main or Sub cannot be equipped.

Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Hand-to-Hand skill, Accuracy, Attack, Double Attack, STR, DEX, Kick Attack Rate and Damage, Critical Hit Rate, Store TP, Subtle Blow, and Weapon Skill Damage as you level.
Combo Momentum: Every landed Hand-to-Hand weapon skill refunds a chunk of TP to keep rapid skillchain pressure rolling.

Aggressive Monk Abilities: Boost adds instant TP plus Critical Hit Rate and Weapon Skill Damage for your next strike; Focus boosts Accuracy, Critical Hit Rate, and Critical Damage; Dodge grants Ability Haste and Subtle Blow; Chakra enhances healing, adds TP, and cleanses Paralysis/Blindness/Weight; Chi Blast hits harder, inflicts Defense Down, and adds TP; Footwork boosts Kick Attacks and Attack; Hundred Fists surges Attack, Critical Hit Rate, Double Attack, and Store TP.

weaponConfig.summary: H2H Oath: You are strictly restricted to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists. Equipping a Staff, Club, Shield, or any other non-Hand-to-Hand item in Main or Sub is forbidden and will be automatically unequipped.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: H2H Oath: You are strictly restricted to Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists. Equipping a Staff, Club, Shield, or any other non-Hand-to-Hand item in Main or Sub is forbidden and will be automatically unequipped.
souls.resourceSystem: Combo Momentum: Every landed Hand-to-Hand weapon skill refunds a chunk of TP to keep rapid skillchain pressure rolling.
mechanics: H2H Oath: Strictly enforces Hand-to-Hand weapons or bare fists; non-H2H Main or Sub items are automatically removed.
Combo Momentum: Every landed Hand-to-Hand weapon skill refunds bonus TP, keeping your weapon-skill cycle unusually fast. Missed weapon skills do not trigger the momentum refund.
Aggressive Monk Abilities:
Boost: Grants instant TP plus bonus Critical Hit Rate and Weapon Skill Damage for your next weapon skill.
Focus: Adds Accuracy, Critical Hit Rate, and Critical Hit Damage.
Dodge: Grants Ability Haste and Subtle Blow.

souls.lore: A high steward of sanctuary and solemn grace whose luminous benedictions shelter the faithful before ruin can fall.
souls.summary: Proactive Barrier-Cure and Afflatus Solace healer (Lv. 10+): converts single-target Cure healing and overhealing into Solace Ward Stoneskin barriers, weaves Banish, Holy, or weapon skills for MP and Sacred Grace Regen pulses, and shields the party with Divine Veil.
souls.atAGlance: Bishop is a proactive barrier-cure White Mage healer that turns healing into layered protection. Under Afflatus Solace (unlocked early at Lv. 10), your single-target Cures wrap allies in Solace Ward—combining a Stoneskin barrier with brief Damage Taken reduction. When the party is steady, weaving Banish, Holy, or Club/Staff weapon skills recovers MP and builds Sacred Grace stacks, which you spend on Curaga, Esuna, or Auspice to pulse sustained party-wide Regen. Supported by Divine Veil, Sanctuary Pulse, and zero-HP-cost Martyr and Devotion, Bishop excels at preventing spikes before they become emergencies.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Max HP, Max MP, MND, VIT, Cure Potency, Fast Cast, Enmity reduction, Refresh, and Shield Block Rate (with Club and Shield) as you level, with full spell-interruption protection under Afflatus.
Proactive Afflatus Solace: Unlocks early at Lv. 10 with instant recast; single-target Cure I–VI apply Solace Ward, wrapping the target in a Stoneskin barrier and 8s of Damage Taken reduction.

Sacred Grace Smite-Weaving: Banish, Holy, or Club/Staff weapon skills restore a share of Max MP and grant +1 Sacred Grace (max 3, 30s); at 3 stacks, Curaga, Esuna, or Auspice triggers a 10s party Regen.

Enhanced White Mage Abilities: Divine Seal (20s CD) adds an extra HP barrier; Martyr and Devotion (15s CD) restore ally HP or MP with zero self-HP loss; Benediction delivers a full party heal and cleanse, major MP restore, and 15s of heavy Damage Taken reduction.

Divine Veil (25s CD, 15y AoE) layers a party barrier, mitigation, and Magic Evasion while splashing your next Cure, Erase, or Esuna; Sanctuary Pulse (20s CD, 15y AoE) delivers an instant party heal, 3-debuff cleanse, and +1 Sacred Grace.

weaponConfig.summary: Equipment: Pairing a Club and Shield unlocks passive Shield Block bonuses and extra survivability; a Staff also remains viable if you prefer pure casting stats. Prioritize Max HP, Max MP, MND, Cure Potency, Fast Cast, and Refresh.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Equipment: Pairing a Club and Shield unlocks passive Shield Block bonuses and extra survivability; a Staff also remains viable if you prefer pure casting stats. Prioritize Max HP, Max MP, MND, Cure Potency, Fast Cast, and Refresh.
souls.resourceSystem: Sacred Grace Smite-Weaving: Banish, Holy, or Club/Staff weapon skills restore a share of Max MP and grant +1 Sacred Grace (max 3, 30s); at 3 stacks, Curaga, Esuna, or Auspice triggers a 10s party Regen.
mechanics: Afflatus Solace & Solace Ward: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (0s recast). Grants full Spell Interruption Rate Down while active. Single-target Cure I–VI apply Solace Ward, converting healing and overhealing into a Stoneskin barrier (capped by target Max HP) plus 8 seconds of Damage Taken reduction.

Sacred Grace (Max 3 Stacks, 30s duration): Built by casting Banish or Holy, landing a Club or Staff weapon skill (each also restoring Max MP), or using Sanctuary Pulse. At 3 stacks, casting Curaga, Esuna, or Auspice consumes the stacks to grant a 10-second party Regen.

Divine Veil: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (25s recast, 15y party AoE). Grants a party HP barrier, Damage Taken reduction, and Magic Evasion, and causes your next Cure, Erase, or Esuna to splash to nearby allies.
Sanctuary Pulse: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (20s recast, 15y party AoE). Delivers an immediate AoE heal, cleanses up to 3 debuffs, and adds 1 Sacred Grace stack.
Enhanced White Mage Abilities:
Divine Seal (20s recast): Adds a bonus HP barrier to your next Cure.

souls.lore: A militant crusader of sacred light who walks the frontlines with staff in hand, answering darkness with radiant conviction.
souls.summary: Melee-fueled Light magic striker (Lv. 10+): fights up close with a Staff to refill MP via Staff Communion, then spends it on high-impact single-target Light spells empowered by Consecration.
souls.atAGlance: Penitent is a melee-fueled single-target Light magic DPS Soul. Instead of standing in the backline conserving MP, you fight up close with a Staff so every damaging melee attack round triggers Staff Communion, refilling your MP on a brisk 3-second cadence. You then pour that MP into high-impact Light spells—Dawnfire, Sunbrand, Pillar of Day, and Last Light—and amplify your biggest openings with Consecration. Penitent is a focused damage dealer, not the party's main healer.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Staff skill, Melee Accuracy, MND, Magic Attack Bonus, and Magic Accuracy as you level.
Staff Communion: Damaging Staff melee attack rounds restore a portion of Max MP (at most once every 3s), growing stronger as you level.
Light Spell Arsenal: Unlocks Dawnfire and Consecration at Lv. 10, Sunbrand at Lv. 30, and Pillar of Day and Last Light at Lv. 50 (with Last Light intensifying further at Lv. 70).
Consecration (90s CD, 20s window): Substantially amplifies your next landed damaging Penitent spell—hold it for clean, uninterrupted burst openings.

weaponConfig.summary: Required weapon: Keep a Staff equipped in your Main slot. Your custom Light spells, Consecration, and Staff Communion all require a Staff.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Required weapon: Keep a Staff equipped in your Main slot. Your custom Light spells, Consecration, and Staff Communion all require a Staff.
souls.resourceSystem: Staff Communion: Requires a Staff. Triggers when a Staff melee attack round deals damage, restoring a portion of your Max MP (no more than once every 3 seconds). Its MP return grows stronger as you advance through Lv. 30 and Lv. 70. Staff weapon skills do not trigger Communion.
mechanics: Staff Communion: Requires a Staff. Triggers when a Staff melee attack round deals damage, restoring a portion of your Max MP (no more than once every 3 seconds). Its MP return grows stronger as you advance through Lv. 30 and Lv. 70. Staff weapon skills do not trigger Communion.

Consecration: Unlocked at Lv. 10 (90s recast, 20s duration, requires Staff). Empowers your next damaging Penitent spell. Only a landed damaging Penitent spell consumes the buff—a failed or non-damaging cast does not waste it.
Light Spell Progression (all require Staff):
Dawnfire (Lv. 10): 2s cast, 6s recast. Fast, efficient core Light spell.
Sunbrand (Lv. 30): 2.5s cast, 8s recast. Mid-weight single-target Light spell.
Pillar of Day (Lv. 50): 3s cast, 12s recast. Heavy single-target Light spell.

souls.lore: A winged-spear sentinel of the sacred order who watches over vulnerable allies and steadies their resolve amidst chaos.
souls.summary: Polearm support guardian (Lv. 10+): watches over a designated Wingmate and reacts to hostile spell interruptions with Intercessor's Escort, securing a protected retry of the exact interrupted spell.
souls.atAGlance: Intercessor is a Polearm support Soul specializing in rescuing a single ally after enemy damage interrupts a critical spell. You designate one party caster (or yourself) as your Wingmate, watch for hostile casting interruptions, and answer immediately with Intercessor's Escort to grant a protected 6-second retry of that exact spell. This is a sharp, reactive rescue kit—not permanent interruption immunity—rewarding keen awareness, smart target selection, and split-second timing.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Polearm skill, Max HP, and Magic Evasion as you level.
Wingmate (5s CD, 15y): Designates one living party caster—or yourself when practicing with Vigil Lance—as your guarded partner.
Intercessor's Escort (25s CD, requires Polearm): Reacts to a hostile damage interruption on your Wingmate, opening a 6s window to retry that exact spell protected from damage-based interruption.
Level Milestones: Lv. 30 unlocks an MP refund on completed allied retries; Lv. 50 extends Escort range to 20y and adds a smaller self-retry refund; Lv. 70 strengthens the MP refund further.

weaponConfig.summary: Required weapon: Equip a Polearm in your Main slot. Wingmate, Intercessor's Escort, and Intercessor's support mechanics all require a Polearm.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Required weapon: Equip a Polearm in your Main slot. Wingmate, Intercessor's Escort, and Intercessor's support mechanics all require a Polearm.
souls.resourceSystem: Wingmate: 5s recast, 15y range (Self or one living party member). Reassigning Wingmate to someone else clears any pending retry tied to your previous partner.
mechanics: Wingmate: 5s recast, 15y range (Self or one living party member). Reassigning Wingmate to someone else clears any pending retry tied to your previous partner.

Intercessor's Escort: 25s recast, requires a Polearm (15y range at Lv. 10, expanding to 20y at Lv. 50). Can only be triggered after a hostile damage interruption on your Wingmate—voluntary cancels or movement breaks do not qualify. Only one Intercessor can claim a given interruption.
Protected Retry Window: Grants 6 seconds to start the exact interrupted spell again, shielding that single retry from damage-based interruption.
MP Refund Progression: Unlocks for completed allied retries at Lv. 30, adds a smaller refund for self-retries at Lv. 50 (alongside the 20y Escort range), and scales stronger at Lv. 70.
Vigil Lance: Lv. 10 single-target Light spell (15 MP, 2.5s cast, 15s recast) for offensive contribution between rescues.
Passive Growth: As you level, Intercessor passively strengthens Polearm skill, Max HP, and Magic Evasion to help you hold ground near your Wingmate.

souls.lore: A stargazing archmage who reads celestial alignments to call down cataclysmic astral forces upon Vana’diel’s mightiest foes.
souls.summary: Deliberate Ancient Magic burst caster (Lv. 10+): probes enemies to align Ancient Invocation to their weakest element, then commits to devastating single-target Ancient spells paced by shared recovery and Astral Saturation.
souls.atAGlance: Goetist is a patient, high-commitment single-target Ancient Magic DPS Soul. You read your target using fast elemental probes (and Elemental Survey from Lv. 30) to align Ancient Invocation to the enemy's weakest element, then commit to a long, devastating Ancient Magic cast. Every Ancient puts your kit into an 18-second shared Ancient recovery and marks the target with 20 seconds of Astral Saturation, discouraging back-to-back Ancient stacking. Goetist rewards precision, timing, and elemental mastery rather than frantic spell spam.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens INT, Magic Attack Bonus, Magic Accuracy, and Max MP as you level.
Elemental Probes & Gather Aether (Lv. 10): Six quick probes (1.5s cast, 3s recast) align Ancient Invocation to their element on hit; Gather Aether (90s CD) restores a substantial portion of Max MP.

Survey, Travel & Advanced Ancients: Lv. 30 unlocks Elemental Survey (30s CD) to read weak resistances and Starway (100 MP, 10s CD) for home-point travel; Lv. 50 unlocks six fixed-element 7s-cast Ancient spells that grow even stronger at Lv. 70.
Recovery & Saturation: Every Ancient triggers an 18s shared Ancient recovery, and damaging Ancients apply 20s of Astral Saturation that sharply reduces the unique Soul bonus of follow-up Ancients.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon & stats: A Staff is a natural fit for spellcasting. Prioritize INT, Magic Accuracy, Magic Attack Bonus, and a comfortable MP pool. Your core spell loop requires no weapon-skill talent points or specific subjob.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon & stats: A Staff is a natural fit for spellcasting. Prioritize INT, Magic Accuracy, Magic Attack Bonus, and a comfortable MP pool. Your core spell loop requires no weapon-skill talent points or specific subjob.
souls.resourceSystem: Survey, Travel & Advanced Ancients: Lv. 30 unlocks Elemental Survey (30s CD) to read weak resistances and Starway (100 MP, 10s CD) for home-point travel; Lv. 50 unlocks six fixed-element 7s-cast Ancient spells that grow even stronger at Lv. 70.
mechanics: Elemental Probes (Lv. 10): Cinder (6 MP), Rime (8 MP), Gale (6 MP), Bedrock (4 MP), Static Spark (9 MP), and Tsunami (5 MP). All share a 1.5s cast and 3s recast; landing damage aligns Ancient Invocation to that element.
Ancient Invocation (Lv. 10): 4.5s cast, high MP cost, 18s shared Ancient recovery. Fires the element of your last damaging probe (defaulting to Earth).
Gather Aether (Lv. 10): 90s recast. Restores a meaningful portion of your Max MP (cannot be used at full MP).

Elemental Survey & Starway (Lv. 30): Elemental Survey (1s cast, 30s recast) reads the target's weakest elemental resistance ranks; Starway (4s cast, 100 MP, 10s recast) teleports you to your home point out of combat.

Six Advanced Ancients (Lv. 50, stronger at Lv. 70): Solar Collapse, Rimefall, Skybreak, Worldsplitter, Thunderstar, and Tidal Cataclysm—each a 7s cast with heavy MP cost and the shared 18s Ancient recovery. Against notorious monsters, their unique bonus damage respects a cap relative to the target's encounter HP.
Astral Saturation (20s): Triggered on the target by a damaging Ancient. While active, follow-up Ancients still deal normal spell damage, but their unique Goetist bonus is heavily reduced.

souls.lore: A selfless conduit of arcane current who binds their own aetheric flow to an ally, amplifying a fellow caster’s grandest incantations.
souls.summary: Tactical spell-channeling support (Lv. 10+): commits its own casting window via Conduit Link to make one chosen ally's next spell faster and cheaper, while weaving Conduit Bolt and Aether Tap between links.
souls.atAGlance: Channeler is a tactical spell-support Soul that commits its own casting window to make one chosen ally's next spell faster and cheaper. Conduit Link shines when coordinated right before a healer's major rescue or a caster's heavy nuke, rather than being treated as a passive aura. When playing solo, you can self-link for an MP discount without cast-time acceleration. Between links, Conduit Bolt provides steady single-target damage and Aether Tap siphons MP from spellcasting enemies.
highlights: Scaling Passives: Passively strengthens Max MP, Magic Accuracy, and Max HP as you level.
Conduit Link (Lv. 10, 24s CD, 8s window): Grants cast-time reduction and MP savings to one party caster within 15y (20y at Lv. 50), or self-link at no activation cost for a solo MP discount only.
Allied MP Relay & Aether Tap (Lv. 30): Completed linked allied casts relay a small share of their spent MP back to you, and Aether Tap (10 MP, 60s CD) drains MP from spellcasting enemies.
Link Rules: Cast speed and MP savings scale stronger as you level; Ancient Magic, instant casts, zero-cost spells, and other Channelers cannot receive an allied link.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon: Equip a Staff to complement your spellcasting and eligible weapon skills. Conduit Link works straight away at Lv. 10 with no talent points or required subjob.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon: Equip a Staff to complement your spellcasting and eligible weapon skills. Conduit Link works straight away at Lv. 10 with no talent points or required subjob.
souls.resourceSystem: Conduit Link (Lv. 10): 24s recast, 8s unspent window. Costs a portion of Max MP when targeting an ally (no activation cost when self-linked). Grants cast-time reduction and MP savings to an ally's next eligible spell, with cast speed, MP savings, and range (15y to 20y at Lv. 50) all improving as you level.
mechanics: Conduit Link (Lv. 10): 24s recast, 8s unspent window. Costs a portion of Max MP when targeting an ally (no activation cost when self-linked). Grants cast-time reduction and MP savings to an ally's next eligible spell, with cast speed, MP savings, and range (15y to 20y at Lv. 50) all improving as you level.
Allied MP Relay (Lv. 30+): When a linked ally successfully finishes an eligible spell, a small portion of the MP they spent is relayed back to you. Interrupted casts do not trigger the relay.
Excluded Spells & Targets: Ancient Magic, instant-cast spells, item uses, and zero-MP spells cannot consume Conduit Link. Another Channeler cannot receive an allied link.
Link Priority: An ally can only hold one active link. A stronger unspent link can replace a weaker one, but once the ally begins casting, the reserved link cannot be overwritten.
Solo Self-Link: Applies only the MP discount to your next eligible spell—no cast-time speed boost and no MP relay.
Conduit Bolt (Lv. 10): 9 MP, 2s cast, 4s recast. Reliable single-target offensive spell between links.

souls.lore: A forbidden scholar of twilight and the scythe who binds restless echoes of the fallen to stand watch or whisper dark sorcery.
souls.summary: Scythe-wielding Black Mage who commands undead tank or ranged dark caster summons, sustains thralls through weaponskills, and sacrifices them with Corpse Explosion.
souls.atAGlance: Necromancer is a Scythe-wielding undead commander with two pet-defined roles. Undead Warrior or Dullahan provides a threat-absorbing tank thrall; Undead Mage or Corse supplies dark magic and party offense. Necromancer's personal equipment and Grim Conversion turn conventional Black Mage magic stats into Scythe combat strength. Your playstyle depends on choosing, controlling, and sustaining a single thrall rather than playing like a normal backline nuker.
highlights: Passive Progression: Strengthens Max HP, raises Scythe Skill to A+, and enhances Occult Acumen as you level.

Undead Warrior & Dullahan (Tank Mode): Trades heavy personal damage for a frontline tank thrall with boss AoE/conal immunity, single-target enmity transfer from master to thrall, and healing/overheal forwarding.
Undead Mage & Corse (Caster Mode): Trades some personal damage for reduced personal enmity and a ranged Dark caster thrall that empowers party offense via Grim Incantations.
Harbinger's Drain: Eligible Scythe weapon skills restore a reliable share of Max HP to Tank Thralls or heal Caster Thralls based on weapon-skill damage dealt.
Dark Pact: While an undead summon is alive, grants scaling Double Attack, Store TP, and Accuracy.
Corpse Explosion: Implodes your active summon onto your single engaged target for concentrated Dark damage and Bio without pulling nearby enemies.
Grim Conversion: Converts Magic Accuracy into Accuracy, Magic Attack Bonus into Attack, Fast Cast into Haste, and Magic Burst Bonus into Weapon Skill Damage.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon: Main-hand a Scythe to unlock Harbinger's Drain sustain and your melee combat profile.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon: Main-hand a Scythe to unlock Harbinger's Drain sustain and your melee combat profile.
souls.resourceSystem: Modal roles: Warrior/Dullahan is your pet-tank mode (trading heavy personal damage for thrall survivability and threat control); Mage/Corse is your ranged caster and party support mode (trading some personal damage for dark magic, reduced personal enmity, and party buffs).
mechanics: Modal roles: Warrior/Dullahan is your pet-tank mode (trading heavy personal damage for thrall survivability and threat control); Mage/Corse is your ranged caster and party support mode (trading some personal damage for dark magic, reduced personal enmity, and party buffs).
Summons: Undead Warrior and Undead Mage unlock at Lv. 10; elite Dullahan and Corse unlock at Lv. 75, sharing a 60-second recast.

Tank threat transfer & protections: Single-target enmity generated by the Necromancer redirects to an active tank thrall. Tank thralls are immune to boss AoE and conal attacks, though direct hits still require active maintenance.
Cure forwarding: In tank mode, a large portion of healing—and overhealing—received by the Necromancer forwards directly to the tank thrall.
Pet command recasts: Grim Reaping and Grim Incantations each carry a 30-second recast, while the specialized pet command skills share a 25-second recast within their menu.

Harbinger's Drain: Eligible Scythe weapon skills restore a dependable share of a tank thrall's maximum HP (scaling upward as you level) or heal a caster thrall in proportion to the weapon skill's damage.

souls.lore: An aristocratic fencer who weaves dueling elegance with subtle hexes, meeting overwhelming foes blade-to-blade with unruffled poise.
souls.summary: Frontline duelist tank (Lv. 10+): requires a one-handed Sword with an empty off-hand to unlock Fencer Parry and Riposte mastery, Hex-Mitigation (weakening enemy damage per distinct enfeeble), and instant-cast Stoneskin and Phalanx barrier weaving.
souls.atAGlance: Thornveil is an empty-offhand Sword tank whose enfeebles directly strengthen personal mitigation and Parry. Eligible Sword weapon skills trigger Crimson Flow, opening a brief window for an instant, zero-MP defensive barrier or enfeeble. Crimson Riposte rewards every successful Parry with elemental counter-damage, heavy enmity, and MP recovery. Gameplay revolves around stacking distinct debuffs on your attacker, weaving barriers, and using Sword weapon skills to keep your defenses rolling.
highlights: Crimson Fencer Mastery (1H Sword + Empty Sub): Scales Sword, Enfeebling, and Enhancing skill, Parry Rate, Fast Cast, and grants full spell interruption immunity as you level.
Hex-Mitigation: Reduces incoming physical and magical damage from your attacker and raises your Parry Rate for each distinct active enfeeble on them, stacking up to 5 distinct effects.
Crimson Riposte: Parrying an attack triggers light/ice counter-damage, heavy volatile enmity, and MP recovery.

Barrier & WS Weaving: Enhances Stoneskin (15s recast) and Phalanx (30s recast); eligible Sword weapon skills grant Crimson Flow (6s), making your next Enfeeble, Stoneskin, or Phalanx instant, 0 MP, and high-enmity.

Enhanced RDM Cooldowns: Convert (30s recast) safely preserves at least half HP and refreshes Stoneskin; Composure boosts Accuracy, Magic Accuracy, and Enfeebling duration; Chainspell delivers a 30s defensive and enmity surge.

weaponConfig.summary: Strict weapon setup: Main-hand a one-handed Sword and leave the Sub slot completely empty. Equipping a shield, grip, Dagger, or any other off-hand item disables the core fencer tank engine.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Strict weapon setup: Main-hand a one-handed Sword and leave the Sub slot completely empty. Equipping a shield, grip, Dagger, or any other off-hand item disables the core fencer tank engine.
souls.resourceSystem: Hex-Mitigation: Reduces incoming physical and magical damage from your attacker and raises your Parry Rate for each distinct active enfeeble on them, stacking up to 5 distinct effects.
mechanics: Hex-Mitigation: Each distinct qualifying enfeeble on your attacker reduces the physical and magical damage they deal to you and increases your Parry rate, stacking up to five distinct enfeebles.
Hex Volley: 25-second recast, 8-yalm range; applies multiple distinct enfeebles together and generates substantial enmity.
Crimson Flow: Eligible Sword weapon skills grant a 6-second window for an instant, 0 MP cast of Stoneskin, Phalanx, or a qualifying enfeeble with boosted volatile enmity.
Eligible Sword weapon skills: Flat Blade, Vorpal Blade, Swift Blade, Savage Blade, and Sanguine Blade trigger Crimson Flow.
Crimson Riposte: A qualifying Parry with an empty off-hand triggers light/ice counter-damage, heavy volatile enmity, and MP recovery.
Crimson Fleche: 20-second recast, 6-second duration; boosts Parry and prevents knockback while generating enmity and enabling a free protective Stoneskin.

souls.lore: A courtly strategist of San d’Orian and Jeunoan tradition who reads the ebb of battle to issue decisive, tailored commands.
souls.summary: Choose a useful enfeeble, then make the tactical decision of which ally receives your short-lived order.
souls.atAGlance: Arbiter is an enfeebling support Soul that turns tactical debuffs into targeted ally orders. Successfully landing specific enfeebles prepares a short-lived Advance or Recompose order; you then choose the single teammate who will benefit most and issue it before the window closes. The Soul rewards picking the right enfeeble, reading which ally is about to act, and timing brief eight-second bursts rather than maintaining passive party auras.
highlights: Break Stride and Seize Initiative prepare Advance (Accuracy, plus Store TP at Lv. 30+); Obscure Aim and Quiet Front prepare Recompose (MP refund on completed spells).
Issue Order (15y, 18s recast) grants an 8s targeted buff from a 6s pending order; order potency scales upward as you level.
Lv. 30 Unravel Defense dispels an enemy enhancement and reopens your last issued order; at Lv. 50+, a full resist can prepare a reduced-potency fallback order once every 24s.
Casting a new enfeeble replaces your pending order, and same-kind orders always preserve the highest potency already active on the recipient.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon and stats: A Sword is a practical melee choice, while Magic Accuracy is essential because full enfeeble landings prepare your strongest orders. Your Soul progression also strengthens Max MP as you level.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon and stats: A Sword is a practical melee choice, while Magic Accuracy is essential because full enfeeble landings prepare your strongest orders. Your Soul progression also strengthens Max MP as you level.
souls.resourceSystem: Advance source spells: Break Stride and Seize Initiative (Lv. 10) prepare an Advance order on a successful landing.
mechanics: Advance source spells: Break Stride and Seize Initiative (Lv. 10) prepare an Advance order on a successful landing.
Recompose source spells: Obscure Aim and Quiet Front (Lv. 10) prepare a Recompose order on a successful landing.

Order scaling: Advance grants an Accuracy boost at Lv. 10, gains Store TP at Lv. 30, and scales higher at Lv. 70. Recompose refunds a portion of spent MP on completed eligible casts, growing stronger at Lv. 30 and Lv. 70.
Unravel Defense (Lv. 30): Removes an enemy enhancement and reopens your most recently issued order (or Advance if none has been issued).
Resist fallback (Lv. 50+): A qualifying full resist can prepare a reduced-potency pending order at most once every 24 seconds.
Pending order window: Lasts 6 seconds. Casting another qualifying enfeeble replaces the pending order with the new type.

souls.lore: A virtuoso of crimson duality who balances keen swordplay and refined sorcery, shifting gracefully between steel and spell.
souls.summary: Commit to one offensive form: Yin empowers elemental spell damage, while Yang empowers ordinary main-hand Sword swings.
souls.atAGlance: Conflux is a single-target damage Soul built around committing to one of two offensive forms: Yin empowers your elemental spell kit, while Yang empowers ordinary main-hand Sword swings. You begin in Yang and switch with Spellweave or Bladeweave whenever the encounter favors a different style of offense. Changing forms during combat imposes a brief recovery where neither bonus applies, so deliberate timing beats constant swapping.
highlights: Lv. 10: Spellweave enters Yin and Bladeweave enters Yang; you start in Yang upon activating the Soul.
Combat form changes share a 12s recast and impose a 2s offensive recovery where neither form bonus applies; switch freely outside combat.
Passive Progression: Strengthens Sword skill, Accuracy, DEX, INT, and Magic Attack Bonus as you level.
Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70 unlock heavier elemental weave spells and progressively strengthen your active form bonus.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon: Equip a Sword to take advantage of Yang's main-hand attack bonus. Sword weapon skills follow their normal unlock, TP, and talent rules and do not inherit Yang's ordinary-swing bonus.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon: Equip a Sword to take advantage of Yang's main-hand attack bonus. Sword weapon skills follow their normal unlock, TP, and talent rules and do not inherit Yang's ordinary-swing bonus.
souls.resourceSystem: Yin: Boosts damage from Conflux's eligible elemental spells once the 2-second post-switch recovery ends.
mechanics: Yin: Boosts damage from Conflux's eligible elemental spells once the 2-second post-switch recovery ends.
Yang: Boosts ordinary main-hand Sword swing damage (not weapon skills or off-hand hits).
Form scaling: Both Yin and Yang grow progressively stronger at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70 alongside new elemental spell unlocks.
Combat form switching: Spellweave and Bladeweave share a 12-second recast in combat and impose 2 seconds of offensive recovery. Switching outside combat has no recovery penalty.
Spell progression:
Lv. 10: Searing Needle, Rime Stitch, Gale Needle, Copper Stitch, Storm Needle, and Tide Stitch (1.5-second cast, 3-second recast).

souls.lore: A silver-tongued schemer of misdirection and sleight of hand who orchestrates the flow of attention across the battlefield.
souls.summary: Position behind the party member who should take threat, and weaken enemies with well-timed weapon skills.
souls.atAGlance: Trickster is a support Soul that controls where its own attack threat goes while weakening an enemy's physical offense. Pass the Blame sets up a positional threat transfer to an ally, and Suppression automatically inflicts Attack Down when you land a qualifying weapon skill. You are neither the primary tank nor a dedicated healer: your job is deliberate threat routing and steady enemy Attack Down while helping burn down the party's target.
highlights: Pass the Blame unlocks at Lv. 10 (35s recast, 20s window): position an ally between yourself and the enemy to route your attack threat to them.
Suppression: A damaging Dagger or Sword weapon skill inflicts Attack Down for 16s (scaling stronger as you level) on a separate 20s cooldown.
A missed weapon skill, target immunity, or existing Attack Down leaves the cooldown ready; Suppression works both in parties and solo.
Passive Progression: Strengthens Dagger skill, Accuracy, DEX, and Subtle Blow while reducing personal enmity as you level.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Equip a Dagger or Sword in your main hand. Both Suppression and Pass the Blame check for a compatible main weapon.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Equip a Dagger or Sword in your main hand. Both Suppression and Pass the Blame check for a compatible main weapon.
souls.resourceSystem: Pass the Blame (Lv. 10+): 35-second recast with up to 20 seconds to land a qualifying hit. Routes your attack threat to the party member positioned between you and the target.
mechanics: Pass the Blame (Lv. 10+): 35-second recast with up to 20 seconds to land a qualifying hit. Routes your attack threat to the party member positioned between you and the target.
Suppression (Lv. 10+): A damaging Dagger or Sword weapon skill inflicts Attack Down for 16 seconds. Its potency grows stronger at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70.

Suppression cooldown: Each successful application triggers a separate 20-second cooldown. A miss, zero-damage hit, target immunity, or an existing Attack Down leaves the cooldown ready so you are not punished for failed attempts.
Compatible weapons: Requires a Dagger or Sword in the main hand.
Passive progression: Dagger skill, Accuracy, DEX, Subtle Blow, and personal enmity reduction all improve as you level through Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70.
Soul HUD: Tracks Pass the Blame and Suppression timers and indicates whether the enemy currently has Attack Down (regardless of who applied it).

souls.lore: A ruthless opportunist of back-alley steel who spots the faintest crack in a foe’s guard and strikes without hesitation.
souls.summary: Time a landed Dagger or Sword weapon skill into an enemy opening to exploit their weakness and reclaim TP.
souls.atAGlance: Opportunist is a melee damage Soul built around turning well-timed weapon skills into refunded TP. Find the Gap marks a personal opening on one enemy, while any existing Defense Down on the target also qualifies. Landing a damaging Dagger or Sword weapon skill into that opening triggers Opportunism, reclaiming TP to keep your offense rolling, while Back Alley Strike prepares a positional critical hit from behind.
highlights: Find the Gap (Lv. 10, 5y, 15s duration, 24s recast) marks a personal opening on one enemy; existing enemy Defense Down also qualifies.
Opportunism refunds a scaling chunk of TP whenever a qualified damaging Dagger or Sword weapon skill lands, with a separate 12s personal lockout.
Back Alley Strike (Lv. 10, 45s recast) prepares a positional rear critical hit lasting up to 20s.
Passive Progression: Strengthens Dagger skill, Accuracy, Attack, DEX, Critical Hit Rate, and Store TP as you level.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Main-hand a Dagger or Sword. Both the opening check and the Opportunism TP refund require a compatible weapon when your weapon skill begins and resolves.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Main-hand a Dagger or Sword. Both the opening check and the Opportunism TP refund require a compatible weapon when your weapon skill begins and resolves.
souls.resourceSystem: Opportunism (Lv. 10+): Refunds TP whenever a qualifying Dagger or Sword weapon skill deals positive damage to an exposed target. The TP refund scales upward at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70, with a 12-second personal lockout after each trigger.
mechanics: Opportunism (Lv. 10+): Refunds TP whenever a qualifying Dagger or Sword weapon skill deals positive damage to an exposed target. The TP refund scales upward at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70, with a 12-second personal lockout after each trigger.
Eligibility: The target must have either your personal gap or Defense Down when the weapon skill begins, and you must land positive weapon-skill damage on that same target with a Dagger or Sword.
Find the Gap (Lv. 10+): Single-target personal opening within 5 yalms, lasting 15 seconds with a 24-second recast. It does not apply a party-wide Defense Down debuff.
Consumption rules: Triggering Opportunism consumes your personal gap on that target. A missed or interrupted weapon skill does not trigger Opportunism's 12-second lockout.
Back Alley Strike (Lv. 10+): Prepares a rear-position critical hit for up to 20 seconds on a 45-second recast.
Passive progression: Dagger skill, Accuracy, Attack, DEX, Critical Hit Rate, and Store TP all grow stronger as you level through Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70.

souls.lore: A taunting shadow-dancer who draws every eye and blade onto themselves, slipping past danger like smoke through clenched fingers.
souls.summary: A Dagger or Katana evasion tank that opens with direct threat and holds it as enemy melee swings miss.
souls.atAGlance: Phantom is an evasion tank built around claiming an enemy's attention with a sharp burst of enmity and holding it by dodging genuine melee swings. Phantom's Dare opens with immediate threat and arms a brief single-hit guard against magic or breath attacks. Your job is to keep the target locked onto you through Evasion and HP while timing Dare for dangerous magical spikes, rather than chasing personal damage.
highlights: Phantom's Dare unlocks at Lv. 10 (15y, 18s recast), delivering a strong burst of direct enmity and arming a 6s single-hit guard against magic or breath damage.
The magic/breath guard scales stronger as you level and is never consumed by ordinary melee hits.
Genuine melee evades reinforce threat every 2s while wielding a Dagger or Katana, scaling stronger as you level.
Passive Progression: Strongly enhances Evasion, AGI, Max HP, and Enmity as you level while trading away personal damage output.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Main-hand a Dagger or Katana to activate Phantom's evasion-threat mechanic.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Main-hand a Dagger or Katana to activate Phantom's evasion-threat mechanic.
souls.resourceSystem: Phantom's Dare (Lv. 10+): 15-yalm range, 18-second recast. Delivers a strong burst of cumulative and volatile enmity and arms a 6-second single-hit guard against magic or breath damage.
mechanics: Phantom's Dare (Lv. 10+): 15-yalm range, 18-second recast. Delivers a strong burst of cumulative and volatile enmity and arms a 6-second single-hit guard against magic or breath damage.

Magic & breath guard: Reduces damage from the next qualifying magic or breath hit and then ends immediately, even if time remains on the 6-second window. Ordinary physical hits never spend it, and its mitigation grows stronger at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70.

Evasion threat: Genuine melee evades against a live enemy reinforce your threat at most once every 2 seconds while wielding a Dagger or Katana, scaling stronger at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70. Other avoidance types such as parries or shadows do not count as a genuine melee evade.
Passive progression & tradeoff: Evasion, AGI, Max HP, and Enmity all grow significantly as you level through Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70, paired with a steep reduction to personal damage output.
Soul HUD: Tracks Dare recast, guard duration, evade-threat cooldown, and compatible weapon status.

souls.lore: A frontline hospitaller whose consecrated swings and steadfast presence bring dawn-lit solace to wounded companions in the thick of battle.
souls.summary: Frontline Holy Light and Perpetual Majesty AoE Cure Crusader (Lv. 10+, Club + Shield): splashes single-target Cures party-wide with Light's Grace regeneration, pulses Beacon of Light on melee and weapon skills, and shields allies with Crusader's Aegis.
souls.atAGlance: Lightkeeper is a frontline Paladin combat healer. Its always-on Perpetual Majesty splashes eligible single-target Cures across nearby party members at full potency and converts overhealing into Light's Grace regeneration. Striking enemies with Club melee hits and weapon skills triggers Beacon of Light, healing the most injured nearby ally while restoring MP. Combined with Holy Radiance, Crusader's Aegis, and a transformed emergency rescue kit, Lightkeeper turns Paladin's sturdy frame into a dependable frontline group healer.
highlights: Passive Progression: Strengthens Max HP, Max MP, MND, VIT, Cure Potency, Fast Cast, Refresh, Shield Block, and reduced Enmity as you level, with full spell interruption immunity while wearing a Shield.
Perpetual Majesty: Always active at Lv. 10+ with no lockout; single-target Cures splash to party members within 15y at full potency, and overhealing applies Light's Grace regeneration for 10s.
Beacon of Light: Club melee hits and Club weapon skills heal the lowest-HP ally within 12y (scaling with your Max HP as you level) and restore personal MP.

Enhanced Paladin Abilities: Divine Seal (20s recast, 2-debuff party cleanse), Chivalry (15s recast, MP recovery plus nearby party heal), Rampart (party Damage Taken reduction aura), and Sanctuary Benediction (replaces Invincible with a full party heal, cleanse, and 15s protective ward).

Holy Radiance (20s recast, Club + Shield: 15y AoE heal, 2-debuff cleanse, and MP recovery) and Crusader's Aegis (25s recast, 10s party Damage Taken reduction, knockback immunity, and empowered Beacon of Light).

Holy Radiance: 20-second recast, requires Club + Shield; delivers a strong 15-yalm party heal, cleanses up to two debuffs, and restores MP.
Crusader's Aegis: 25-second recast, 10-second duration (15-yalm party aura); reduces Damage Taken, grants knockback immunity, and significantly boosts Beacon of Light healing while active.

Enhanced Paladin abilities: Chivalry (15-second recast) restores MP and heals nearby allies; Divine Seal (20-second recast) cleanses two debuffs party-wide; Rampart projects a Damage Taken reduction aura; Sanctuary Benediction replaces Invincible with a full party heal, cleanse, and 15-second defensive ward.
Shield stability: Wearing a Shield provides full spell interruption resistance and scaling Block chance as you level.

souls.lore: An oathbound bastion of royal steel who steps willingly into harm’s path, interposing shield and sacred vow between danger and comrades.
souls.summary: Order of the Silver Aegis guardian tank (Lv. 10+): requires a Club and Shield to unlock Divine Intercept (absorbing a share of nearby party damage), build Zeal on blocks and intercepts, and project Holy Retribution party auras.
souls.atAGlance: Martyr is a Club-and-Shield guardian tank that shields nearby allies by intercepting a share of their incoming damage. Every Shield Block or Divine Intercept builds Zeal. At five Zeal, an eligible action unleashes Holy Nova, generating heavy threat and surrounding the party with Holy Retribution protection. Your core rhythm is balancing when to spend Zeal while keeping your HP healthy enough to intercept and your defenses ready to absorb redirected blows.
highlights: Passive Progression: Strengthens Max HP, VIT, MND, Defense, Damage Taken reduction, Enmity, Enmity Retention, and Cure Potency Received as you level.
Club & Shield Mastery: Scales Club and Shield skill, Shield Defense Bonus, Block Rate, and Shield Mastery TP while granting full spell interruption immunity with a Shield.

Divine Intercept: While wielding Club + Shield and staying above 35% HP, redirects a share of damage taken by allies within 10y (widened during Aegis Consecration) onto you with built-in mitigation and AoE safety caps.

Zeal & Holy Retribution (Max 5): Blocking or intercepting builds 1 Zeal (30s duration); at 5 Zeal, Flash, Shield Bash, Judgment Gavel, or a Club weapon skill detonates Holy Nova for heavy enmity, MP recovery, and an 8s party Damage Taken reduction aura.

Club Weapon Skill & JA Engine: Club weapon skills scale with VIT and MND, weaken enemy physical/magical offense (Skullbreaker/Brainshaker), and restore party HP/MP (Starlight/Moonlight); enhances Sentinel, Rampart, Chivalry, and Invincible.

weaponConfig.summary: Required equipment: Main-hand a one-handed Club and off-hand a Shield. Divine Intercept, Zeal, Club weapon-skill sustain, and your custom abilities all require both, and your Shield grants complete spell interruption immunity.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Required equipment: Main-hand a one-handed Club and off-hand a Shield. Divine Intercept, Zeal, Club weapon-skill sustain, and your custom abilities all require both, and your Shield grants complete spell interruption immunity.

mechanics: Divine Intercept: Requires Club + Shield and staying above 35% HP. Redirects a meaningful share of qualifying damage taken by party members within 10 yalms onto you (an even larger share during Aegis Consecration), with built-in mitigation and per-hit / AoE safety caps.
Zeal: Stacks up to 5 for 30 seconds. Blocking or intercepting grants 1 Zeal; Judgment Gavel grants 3 Zeal.

Holy Nova & Holy Retribution: At 5 Zeal, casting Flash or using Shield Bash, Judgment Gavel, or a Club weapon skill spends your stacks for an area light burst, heavy enmity, personal MP recovery, and an 8-second party Damage Taken reduction aura.
Judgment Gavel: 20-second recast, 4-yalm range; deals VIT/MND-scaled blunt damage, briefly stuns and weakens the target, and awards 3 Zeal.
Aegis Consecration: 25-second recast, 10-second duration (10-yalm aura); raises Block chance, expands Divine Intercept coverage, pulses area enmity, and heals you from blocked damage.
Club & Shield Mastery: Unlocks spell interruption immunity with a Shield, boosted Block chance and Shield Mastery TP, VIT/MND-scaled Club weapon skills, and party-supportive weapon-skill effects.

souls.lore: A grim knight who casts aside gentle restraint for a singular, uncompromising vow of judgment carried on a heavy greatsword.
souls.summary: Commit before combat to vulnerable Great Sword pressure or a reactive retaliation vow.
souls.atAGlance: Oathbreaker is a Great Sword damage Soul built around committing to a combat vow before the pull. Vow of Condemnation empowers your regular Great Sword swings at the cost of increased vulnerability, while Vow of Absolution prepares a fierce retaliation window whenever you absorb a heavy direct hit. Your signature strike, Reckoning, hits dramatically harder against the specific enemy that triggered your retaliation. This is a dedicated frontline damage Soul, not a traditional Paladin tank.
highlights: Vow of Condemnation boosts regular Great Sword swings (scaling stronger as you level) in exchange for taking increased incoming enemy damage.
Vow of Absolution provides no mitigation, instead opening a retaliation window (5s, or 7s at Lv. 50+) after you absorb a heavy single direct hit.
Reckoning (4y, 18s recast) strikes dramatically harder against the specific enemy that opened retaliation; vows can only change outside combat and off hate lists (5s shared recast).
Passive Progression: Strengthens Great Sword skill, STR, Accuracy, and Attack as you level.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon: Equip a Great Sword—Reckoning and your retaliation engine both require it.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon: Equip a Great Sword—Reckoning and your retaliation engine both require it.
souls.resourceSystem: Vow of Condemnation: Strengthens regular Great Sword swings (scaling upward at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70) in exchange for taking increased enemy damage.
mechanics: Vow of Condemnation: Strengthens regular Great Sword swings (scaling upward at Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70) in exchange for taking increased enemy damage.

Vow of Absolution: Grants no mitigation; instead, taking a heavy single direct hit from a living enemy with a Great Sword equipped opens a retaliation window against that attacker (5 seconds before Lv. 50, extending to 7 seconds at Lv. 50+).

Reckoning: 4-yalm range, 18-second recast, requires a Great Sword. Deals heavy physical damage that scales upward at Lv. 30 and Lv. 70, and becomes vastly stronger when used against the enemy that triggered your active Absolution retaliation.
Ashen Judgment: Lv. 10 single-target light spell (15 MP, 2-second cast, 15-second recast).
Vow swapping: 5-second shared recast; only permitted outside combat and off all enemy hate lists.
Unlocked Paladin tools: Sentinel (300-second recast) and Shield Bash (60-second recast) unlock at Lv. 10 for emergency utility.

souls.lore: A patient executioner of the curved scythe who watches for a foe’s fleeting moment of vulnerability and harvests it in silence.
souls.summary: A Scythe executioner who times devastating single-target strikes as enemies recover from their own attacks.
souls.atAGlance: Harbinger is a single-target Scythe damage Soul that punishes enemies the moment they finish their own attacks. Whenever an enemy completes a damaging spell, a damaging TP move, or its sixth ordinary melee round, it opens a 5-second Recovery window. You capitalize on that opening with a devastating Finality strike and can layer Grave Toll dark magic without spending your personal Finality opportunity.
highlights: Completed damaging enemy spells, damaging TP moves, or every sixth completed enemy melee round open a 5-second Recovery window.
Finality (4y, 16s recast) deals baseline Scythe damage outside Recovery and dramatically heavier damage during Recovery, scaling stronger as you level.
Starting at Lv. 50 (and improving at Lv. 70), a Recovery Finality gains an added execute bonus against weakened enemies under a quarter HP.
Grave Toll (12 MP, 1.5s cast, 12s recast) deals single-target dark magic damage—much stronger during Recovery—without healing or spending Finality's opening.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon: Equip a Scythe. Finality requires a Scythe within 4 yalms, and Scythe is your core weapon-skill family.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon: Equip a Scythe. Finality requires a Scythe within 4 yalms, and Scythe is your core weapon-skill family.
souls.resourceSystem: Recovery trigger: A completed damaging enemy spell, a damaging enemy TP move, or every sixth completed ordinary enemy melee round opens a 5-second Recovery window.
mechanics: Recovery trigger: A completed damaging enemy spell, a damaging enemy TP move, or every sixth completed ordinary enemy melee round opens a 5-second Recovery window.

Finality (Lv. 10+): 4-yalm range, 16-second recast, requires a Scythe. Deals baseline physical damage outside Recovery and dramatically heavier damage during Recovery, scaling stronger at Lv. 30 and Lv. 70. Starting at Lv. 50 (and improving at Lv. 70), Recovery Finality gains an added execute bonus against targets under a quarter HP.

Grave Toll (Lv. 10+): Ranged single-target dark magic (12 MP, 1.5-second cast, 12-second recast). Deals significantly increased damage during Recovery, does not heal, and does not consume your Finality opportunity.
Individual opportunity: Multiple Reapers can benefit from the same enemy's Recovery window; each Harbinger's damaging Finality consumes only their own opportunity for that window.
Passive progression: Scythe skill, STR, Accuracy, and Attack all grow stronger through Lv. 30, Lv. 50, and Lv. 70.
Soul HUD: Tracks remaining Recovery time while Finality is available, enemy melee-round count toward the sixth round, and Finality's recast.

souls.lore: An imposing juggernaut of dark plate and crimson resolve who drinks deeply of shadow to outlast the fiercest onslaught.
souls.summary: Abyssal blood-knight tank (Lv. 10+): wield a Scythe to unlock Max-HP-scaled Drain II Blood-Pool overcap, instant Absorb weaving for Blood Tithe, HP-costed Dread Spikes barriers, and Vampiric Scythe weapon-skill sustain.
souls.atAGlance: Dreadnought is a Scythe drain-and-barrier tank. Drain II creates a temporary Blood-Pool maximum-HP overcap, while Absorb spells, Abyssal Cleave, and blood-enhanced melee swings build Blood Tithe. You spend Blood Tithe to raise an empowered Dread Spikes physical barrier, then use eligible Scythe weapon skills to heal yourself, extend Blood-Pool, and weaken the enemy. Your defining tactical choice is deciding when to sacrifice health for a stronger barrier versus when to drain or weapon-skill that health back.
highlights: Growing Tank Passives: Max HP, VIT, INT, Defense, Damage Taken reduction, Enmity, and Enmity Retention scale steadily as you level up.
Scythe & Dark Magic Mastery: Scales Scythe and Dark Magic skill, Parry rate, faster Dark Magic casting, and complete Spell Interruption immunity on Dark Magic.

Blood-Pool, Blood Tithe & Dread Spikes: Drain II (12 MP, 30s recast) heals based on Max HP and VIT while granting a 30s Max HP overcap; instant Absorb-STR/VIT/TP/ACC (18s shared recast) restore MP and grant 1 Blood Tithe (max 3); Dread Spikes (45s recast, 0 MP, spends current HP) consumes Tithe to build a larger physical barrier.

Vampiric Scythe Sustain & Souleater: Eligible Scythe weapon skills heal you, extend Drain II by 6s, and inflict Cripple (15s), healing even more under Drain II, Souleater, or Dread Bastion; Souleater (45s recast, 12s) grants mitigation while spending a little HP per swing for threat, Blood Tithe, and Blood Reap.

Tank Abilities: Abyssal Cleave (25s recast, 2s Stun, heavy threat, Breach, MP recovery, +1 Blood Tithe); Dread Bastion (60s recast, 12s mitigation, Knockback immunity, AoE threat pulses every 2s, amplified WS healing); enhanced Blood Weapon sustain and shared Arcane Circle ward.

weaponConfig.summary: Required weapon: Main-hand a Scythe. Your signature drain, instant barrier, parry, and weapon-skill recovery mechanics all depend on wielding a Scythe.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Required weapon: Main-hand a Scythe. Your signature drain, instant barrier, parry, and weapon-skill recovery mechanics all depend on wielding a Scythe.
souls.resourceSystem: Blood Tithe: Caps at 3 stacks and lasts roughly 30 seconds. Built by Absorb spells, Abyssal Cleave, and qualifying Souleater swings; spent to empower Dread Spikes.
mechanics: Blood Tithe: Caps at 3 stacks and lasts roughly 30 seconds. Built by Absorb spells, Abyssal Cleave, and qualifying Souleater swings; spent to empower Dread Spikes.
Drain II / Blood-Pool: Costs 12 MP on a 30-second recast. Recovers health scaled by your maximum HP and VIT, and grants a temporary maximum-HP overcap lasting 30 seconds.

Dread Spikes: Instant with a Scythe on a 45-second recast. Costs 0 MP, sacrifices a portion of your current HP, and requires your health to stay above critically low levels. Each Blood Tithe stack consumed enlarges the resulting physical barrier.

Vampiric Scythe weapon skills: Shadow of Death, Nightmare Scythe, Vorpal Scythe, Guillotine, Catastrophe, and Insurgency trigger your self-healing, extend Blood-Pool by 6 seconds, and inflict Cripple for 15 seconds.

Souleater (Blood Carapace): 45-second recast, 12-second duration. Grants damage reduction while spending a small amount of HP per swing to build enmity, generate Blood Tithe, and prepare Blood Reap for stronger weapon-skill healing.
Absorb Weaving: Absorb-STR, Absorb-VIT, Absorb-TP, and Absorb-ACC cast instantly on a shared 18-second recast, restoring MP and granting 1 Blood Tithe stack.

souls.lore: A feared hex-bearer who lays targeted maledictions upon a monster’s deadliest nature, stifling ruin before it can unfold.
souls.summary: Single-target curse support (Lv. 10+): choose one targeted curse to blunt the enemy action threatening your party most, with a brief single-use ward even against dark-immune foes.
souls.atAGlance: Maleficar is a single-target curse support Soul. Rather than stacking every debuff at once, you choose one targeted curse to blunt the specific enemy threat endangering your party right now. Withering weakens dangerous physical enemy techniques, Ash dampens damaging enemy spells, and Famine (unlocked at Lv. 30) curtails enemy self-healing. Even against enemies with explicit dark immunity, your curses can leave a brief one-use immunity ward so you still bring meaningful defensive value.
highlights: Withering and Ash unlock at Lv. 10, dampening dangerous enemy physical techniques or direct damaging spells with potency that grows as you level up.
Famine unlocks at Lv. 30, curtailing standard enemy combat self-healing with scaling strength.
Curses cost 10 MP, share a 12s recast, and last up to 24s (12s on partial resist); a full resist leaves your existing curse active.
Explicit dark immunity can grant an 8s, single-use party ward at reduced strength (24s cooldown) against one matching hit or heal.
Growing Support Passives: Magic Accuracy, Max MP, and Max HP increase steadily with level, supported by Rite of Malice (24s recast) for MP recovery.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapon: Scythe is the eligible weapon-skill family. Your curse toolkit works independently of weapon-skill talents and pairs freely with any subjob.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapon: Scythe is the eligible weapon-skill family. Your curse toolkit works independently of weapon-skill talents and pairs freely with any subjob.
souls.resourceSystem: Explicit dark immunity can grant an 8s, single-use party ward at reduced strength (24s cooldown) against one matching hit or heal.
mechanics: Curse lineup: Withering (Lv. 10) dampens qualifying physical and ranged enemy special techniques; Ash (Lv. 10) dampens qualifying direct damaging spells; Famine (Lv. 30) reduces an enemy's own qualifying combat self-heals. All three grow stronger as you level up.
Curse duration and resistance: A full landing lasts 24 seconds; a partial resist lasts 12 seconds. If a new curse is fully resisted, your existing curse remains intact.
Shared recast and cost: Withering, Ash, and Famine each cost 10 MP, have a 1-second cast time, and share a 12-second recast.

Immunity ward: Casting on an explicitly dark-immune enemy can place an 8-second, one-use matching ward at reduced strength. The ward has its own 24-second cooldown and requires that no matching curse is already active.
Rite of Malice: Restores MP scaled to your level (up to your missing MP) on a 24-second recast. Requires your current enemy to bear your active curse or ward.
Passive progression: Your Magic Accuracy, Max MP, and Max HP increase steadily as you gain levels.

souls.lore: A wild-hearted hunter who moves in primal tandem with a ferocious companion, turning master and beast into one relentless predator.
souls.summary: Single-target melee damage Soul (Lv. 10+): fight in lockstep with an offensive hare companion, trading TP back and forth as you both land attacks on the same quarry.
souls.atAGlance: Packmate is a single-target melee damage Soul built around fighting in lockstep with an offensive hare companion. You and your hare trade TP back and forth as you land attacks on the same quarry, creating a brisk master-and-companion rhythm. Keep both of you focused on one target, time Pack Rend and Raking Kick around your TP-link cooldowns, and protect your hare without expecting it to tank.
highlights: Lv. 10 Core Loop: Call Packmate, Set Quarry, Pack Rend, and Raking Kick form a complete master-and-companion rhythm right away.
Master-to-Hare Link: Landing Pack Rend or eligible Axe and Great Axe weapon skills on your shared quarry feeds your hare a burst of TP that grows with level.
Hare-to-Master Link: Landing Raking Kick on your shared quarry returns a burst of TP to you; each link direction recovers independently over 8s.
Lv. 30+ Growth: Rally Packmate adds a separate summon recast at Lv. 30, while TP transfers and your hare's Attack, Accuracy, and Double Attack scale up with level.
