souls.lore: A swaggering cutlass-and-pistol privateer who thrives at point-blank range, turning black-powder bravado into hardened resolve.
souls.summary: Sword-and-Gun Corsair tank (Lv. 10+): pairs a one-handed Sword and Gun (with optional Buckler or empty-Sub Pistol Guard) to weave Point-Blank Pistol weapon skills, Salt-Spray Stoneskin, and full Bullet and Card recycle.
souls.atAGlance: Blackwake is a Sword-and-Gun Corsair tank that anchors the frontline with steady enmity, self-healing, and reactive barriers. You generate threat and Grapeshot stacks through Grapeshot Broadside and one-handed Sword weapon skills (Point-Blank Pistol), then spend those stacks with Quick Draw to raise Salt-Spray Stoneskin shields and apply elemental disruption. Galleon's Roll supplies your core defensive aura, while Iron Hull serves as your heavy mitigation and recovery cooldown.
highlights: Passive Progression: Strengthens Max HP, VIT, AGI, Defense, damage mitigation, Parry, Enmity, Enmity Retention, and Sword/Marksmanship skill as you level, with full Bullet and Card recycle and chance-based Pistol Guard when Sub is empty.
Galleon's Roll (20s recast, self-only): Grants 60s of boosted Defense, damage reduction, and Enmity.

Point-Blank Pistol & Salt-Spray: One-handed Sword weapon skills fire a single-target enmity blast, restore personal HP, and grant 1 Grapeshot stack (max 3); Quick Draw consumes Grapeshot for a scaled 12s Stoneskin and elemental disruption.

Grapeshot Broadside (25s recast, 12y) generates single-target enmity, inflicts Blind and Slow, and awards 2 Grapeshot stacks; Iron Hull (45s recast, 12s) delivers heavy mitigation, Knockback Immunity, a hearty self-heal, and personal debuff cleansing.

souls.atAGlance: Ironlink is a Valoredge Automaton proxy tank where you and your mechanical partner hold the line as a single defensive unit. Your Valoredge Automaton leads single-target threat with enhanced Strobe, Shield Bash, and Cannibal Blade, while you reinforce its hate and health through Hydraulic Slam, Hand-to-Hand weapon skills, and oil-free Repair. Clockwork Bulwark links you and your automaton to split incoming damage, and Ventriloquy instantly fixes enmity swings.
highlights: Passive Progression (Hand-to-Hand): Scales Master and Pet HP, VIT, DEX, Defense, damage mitigation, Enmity, Guard, and Hand-to-Hand/Automaton Melee skill as you level, with full Overload Immunity and AoE/conal protection for your automaton.

Single-Target Valoredge AI: Uses enhanced Strobe (12s recast Provoke + Blind), Shield Bash (18s recast, 2s Stun), Cannibal Blade (pet self-heal + volatile enmity), and a shortened 20s Ventriloquy swap with bonus volatile enmity and 8s of damage reduction.

Hand-to-Hand WS & Oil-Free Repair: Hand-to-Hand weapon skills heal Valoredge, grant you a 12s Alloy Plating Stoneskin, and inflict Cripple; oil-free Repair (25s recast) heavily heals Valoredge, restores your own HP, and cleanses 1 debuff.

Clockwork Bulwark (35s recast, 12s) splits incoming hits between you and Valoredge at reduced damage while granting mitigation and Knockback Immunity; Hydraulic Slam (22s recast, 6y) delivers a single-target strike with a 2s Stun, Breach, and pet enmity reinforcement.

souls.lore: A compassionate alchemist-mechanic who guides a restorative automaton with subtle elemental signals to mend and shelter allies.
souls.summary: Martial Automaton Medic and tactical maneuver healer (Lv. 10+, Hand-to-Hand): pairs built-in Automaton White Magic and full Overload Immunity with Light/Water/Earth Maneuver directives and Hand-to-Hand Synchronized Overclock.
souls.atAGlance: Patchwork is a martial Automaton Medic and tactical maneuver healer that pairs Hand-to-Hand combat with a dedicated White Magic automaton. Rather than brawling for damage, your automaton focuses on curing, cleansing, and defensive support while enjoying full Overload Immunity. Light, Water, and Earth Maneuvers issue immediate healing, cleansing, and shielding directives, while Hand-to-Hand weapon skills build Aether Cells, restore pet MP, and unleash party support pulses. Aether Overhaul spends stored Cells for major group recovery and automaton recast resets.
highlights: Passive Progression (Hand-to-Hand): Scales Max HP, MND, VIT, DEX, Cure and Repair Potency, Subtle Blow, Guard, Hand-to-Hand and Automaton skills, and enmity reduction as you level, with full Overload Immunity.

Automaton Medic (Harlequin/Stormwaker/Soulsoother): Enjoys enhanced pet HP/MP, mitigation, Fast Cast, Refresh, low enmity, AoE/breath protection, and built-in Cure I–V, Erase, and status-removal White Magic from Lv. 10+.

Maneuver Directives (10s shared recast): Light issues an immediate single-target mend and Cure splash; Water restores pet MP, erases 1 debuff, and pulses a 12y Regen Mist; Earth grants Stoneskin and converts cure overhealing into extra Stoneskin.

Synchronized Overclock: Hand-to-Hand weapon skills restore pet MP, shorten pet recasts, grant 1 Aether Cell (max 3), and fire a Light/Water/Earth party pulse; oil-free Repair (30s recast) restores pet HP/MP with 12s party Regen; Ventriloquy and Cooldown (30s recast) shed enmity and grant 1 Cell.

Landing a master Hand-to-Hand weapon skill feeds your automaton a burst of TP and marks the foe with Tandem Opening, empowering your automaton's follow-up weapon skill and extending the Skillchain window. Tandem Barrage accelerates both TP bars while weakening enemy Defense, and Limiter Release unleashes a high-speed burst window for master and machine alike.
highlights: Passive Progression (Hand-to-Hand): Scales Master and Pet Attack/Ranged Attack, Martial Arts, Double Attack, Pet Haste, Critical Hit Rate, Hand-to-Hand and Automaton Melee/Ranged skill, and enmity reduction as you level, with full Overload Immunity.

Tandem Combo Loop: Master Hand-to-Hand weapon skills feed your automaton a surge of TP and apply an 8s single-target Tandem Opening mark that empowers String Shredder, Armor Shatterer, Arcuballista, or Bone Crusher and extends the Skillchain window by 3s.

Tandem Barrage (25s recast, 6y) strikes a single target, generates TP for both master and automaton, and inflicts Defense Down for 10s; Limiter Release (35s recast, 12s) boosts Attack/Ranged Attack and Double Attack/Rapid Shot at the cost of Defense, while Overdrive grants enhanced Pet Store TP and 0s Maneuver recasts.

mechanics: Tandem Opening: An 8-second, single-target mark applied by your Hand-to-Hand weapon skills, which also feed your automaton a surge of TP. When your automaton follows up with String Shredder, Armor Shatterer, Arcuballista, or Bone Crusher, the mark is consumed for bonus damage and extends the Skillchain window by 3 seconds.

Tandem Barrage: 25-second recast, 6-yalm single-target strike (requires Hand-to-Hand and an active automaton). Deals physical damage, grants a burst of TP to both master and automaton, and inflicts Defense Down for 10 seconds.
Limiter Release: 35-second recast, 12-second duration. Greatly increases Attack/Ranged Attack and Double Attack/Rapid Shot for both master and automaton, at the tradeoff of lowered Defense.
Overdrive Synergy: Grants your automaton enhanced Store TP and reduces Maneuver recasts to 0 seconds while active, enabling rapid tactical maneuver cycling.
Offensive Frame Focus & Overload Immunity: Favors Valoredge and Sharpshot frames with full Overload Immunity; Tandem is tuned purely for tandem offense rather than automaton curing.

souls.lore: A velvet-cloaked reveler of crimson waltzes who siphons vitality from the heat of combat to sustain every partner on the floor.
souls.summary: MP-free Crimson Blood-Dancer healer (Lv. 10+): converts physical damage into party Drain Samba lifesteal and Crimson Veil Stoneskin barriers, while detonating Finishing Moves on Dagger and Throwing weapon skills.
souls.atAGlance: Revel is an MP-free combat healer driven by melee lifesteal, TP, and Finishing Moves. Your physical attacks fuel Crimson Drain Samba, turning damage dealt into party healing within 15 yalms and converting excess recovery into Crimson Veil Stoneskin barriers. Steps and Nocturne Feast build Finishing Moves, while Dagger and Throwing weapon skills detonate them into group heals and debuff cleanses. Because your personal damage is traded down to support this sustain engine, steady uptime and well-timed group recovery matter far more than chasing top DPS.
highlights: Passive Progression: Strengthens Max HP, DEX, AGI, CHR, Waltz Potency, Subtle Blow, Store TP, Regain, and enmity reduction as you level.
Crimson Drain Samba: Party members within 15y heal from physical damage dealt (scaling higher with level), and overhealing converts into a capped Crimson Veil Stoneskin barrier.

Sanguine Flourish: Steps award 2 Finishing Moves and an immediate party heal; Dagger and Throwing weapon skills consume up to 5 Finishing Moves for scaled 15y AoE healing and a 1-debuff cleanse per ally.

JA Enhancements: Trance waives Waltz TP costs, amplifies Crimson Drain Samba, and triggers full 5-move weapon-skill healing without spending Finishing Moves; Contradance (15s recast) empowers your next Waltz and grants 10s of party damage reduction.

Sanguine Waltz (18s recast, 200 TP, 15y AoE) delivers a strong party heal, up to 2 debuff cleanses, and 15s of Regen; Nocturne Feast (25s recast, 8y) drains foe HP into party healing, awards bonus party TP, and refills your Finishing Moves to 5.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Use Dagger or Throwing weapon skills to trigger Sanguine Flourish Finishing Move heals and cleanses. Daggers excel at steady melee uptime; keep a throwing option handy if your build leans on Throwing weapon skills.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Use Dagger or Throwing weapon skills to trigger Sanguine Flourish Finishing Move heals and cleanses. Daggers excel at steady melee uptime; keep a throwing option handy if your build leans on Throwing weapon skills.
souls.resourceSystem: Sanguine Flourish: Steps award 2 Finishing Moves and an immediate party heal; Dagger and Throwing weapon skills consume up to 5 Finishing Moves for scaled 15y AoE healing and a 1-debuff cleanse per ally.
mechanics: Crimson Drain Samba & Crimson Veil: Allies within 15 yalms heal from physical damage dealt, with lifesteal strength scaling higher as you level. Overhealing automatically converts into a capped Crimson Veil Stoneskin barrier.

Sanguine Flourish: Steps grant 2 Finishing Moves and an immediate party heal. Landing a Dagger or Throwing weapon skill consumes up to 5 Finishing Moves for scaling AoE healing and a 1-debuff cleanse per ally within 15 yalms.
Sanguine Waltz: 18-second recast, 200 TP (free during Trance), 15-yalm party AoE. Delivers a strong party heal, removes up to 2 debuffs, and applies 15 seconds of party Regen.
Nocturne Feast: 25-second recast, 8-yalm range. Drains life from the target to heal nearby party members, awards nearby allies bonus TP, and sets your Finishing Moves to 5.
Contradance: Shortened 15-second recast. Empowers your next Waltz and grants nearby allies a 10-second damage-reduction ward.
Trance: Waives Waltz TP costs, amplifies Crimson Drain Samba lifesteal, and allows Dagger/Throwing weapon skills to trigger full 5-Finishing-Move party heals without spending your Finishing Moves.

souls.lore: An acrobatic skirmisher of spinning chakrams who keeps the rhythm of the dance alive from beyond the crush of steel.
souls.summary: Ranged Chakram Dancer: auto-attacks with your equipped Chakram when out of melee range (or at all ranges with Throwing Stance), unlocks 12 custom Throwing weapon skills, and lets Steps, Flourishes, and Sambas work at range.
souls.atAGlance: Bladewheel is a ranged Chakram damage Dancer that trades close-range Dagger pressure for mobile Throwing combat. Its Throwing Stance determines whether it throws its Chakram even at point-blank distance, and its Steps, Flourishes, and Sambas function at extended range. A suite of custom Throwing weapon skills provides builders, utility, and finishing attacks such as Flamenco Finale.
highlights: Auto-attacks with your equipped Chakram when outside melee range.
Throwing Stance (5s recast toggle): replaces close-range melee swings with Chakram throws at all ranges (0–20y).
Unlocks 12 custom Dancer Throwing weapon skills from Lv. 5 to Lv. 75.
Steps and offensive Flourishes operate up to 20 yalms.
Drain, Aspir, and Haste Samba trigger on ranged Chakram hits.
Passives grow with level, strengthening Ranged Accuracy, Ranged Attack, Snapshot, AGI, and CHR.

weaponConfig.summary: Essential equipment: Equip a compatible Chakram in the Ranged slot, not the Ammo slot, so the ranged auto-attack loop activates properly.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Essential equipment: Equip a compatible Chakram in the Ranged slot, not the Ammo slot, so the ranged auto-attack loop activates properly.
souls.resourceSystem: Throwing Stance (5s recast toggle): replaces close-range melee swings with Chakram throws at all ranges (0–20y).
mechanics: Throwing Stance: A 5-second-recast toggle that forces Chakram throws in place of melee auto-attacks at all ranges (0–20y). With it off, close-range swings revert to Daggers.
Extended Dancer actions: Eligible Steps, offensive Flourishes, and Samba triggers operate up to 20 yalms when your ranged setup is active.
Custom Throwing weapon skills: Unlocks 12 specialized Throwing weapon skills from Lv. 5 to Lv. 75, each following its own level and TP requirements.
Finishing Moves: Built through Steps and select Throwing weapon skills. Flamenco Finale scales its damage with every Finishing Move spent, rewarding disciplined stack timing.
Utility options: Named Throwing skills include Whirling Waltz for light healing, Crimson Samba for dark HP drain, Grand Jete for Defense Down, and Aurora Fandango for Samba support.
Samba aftermath: Terpsichore's Halo grants a Samba-themed aftermath buff on successful use.

souls.lore: A mesmerizing troupe-guardian whose whirling twin daggers and fan-lit footwork lure strikes into graceful, dazzling deflections.
souls.summary: Acrobatic frontline Dancer tank (Lv. 10+): requires Dual Daggers to unlock Fan Dance Rhythm (recharged by Dagger weapon skills), Aegis Waltz Stoneskin barriers, and single-target Step and Cadence control.
souls.atAGlance: Dervish is a dual-Dagger parry and Waltz-shield tank. Its version of Fan Dance grants strong physical and magical mitigation without locking out Waltzes, while Steps generate Finishing Moves, threat, and Cripple stacks. Spending Finishing Moves on qualifying Flourishes raises Aegis Waltz barriers, and Dagger weapon skills recharge decaying Fan Dance protection. Success comes from actively building, spending, and refreshing your defenses rather than sitting passively in one stance.
highlights: Passives grow with level, strengthening Max HP, VIT, DEX, Defense, damage mitigation, Enmity, and threat retention.
Dual Dagger Mastery grants Dual Wield delay reduction alongside growing Parry Rate, Subtle Blow, Dagger skill, and Parrying skill.

Fan Dance Rhythm (15s recast, does not lock Waltzes): grants strong physical and magical damage reduction that decays per hit down to a baseline floor; Dagger weapon skills restore mitigation and grant 1 Finishing Move.

Steps (5s recast, 0 TP): generate 2 Finishing Moves, snap threat, and stackable Cripple (up to 3 stacks); qualifying Flourishes grant an Aegis Waltz Stoneskin barrier scaling with Finishing Moves spent plus a self-cleanse.

Pirouette Deflect (40s recast, Self 8s) resets Fan Dance, boosts Parry, grants Knockback Immunity, and enables reactive counters; Dazzling Cadence (25s recast, 6y single-target) delivers heavy threat, a 2s Stun, Blind, Slow, and 3 Finishing Moves.

weaponConfig.summary: Stats: Prioritize Max HP, VIT, DEX, AGI, Defense, Parry, Dagger skill, Enmity, Waltz Potency, and enough Accuracy to land weapon skills reliably.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Stats: Prioritize Max HP, VIT, DEX, AGI, Defense, Parry, Dagger skill, Enmity, Waltz Potency, and enough Accuracy to land weapon skills reliably.
souls.resourceSystem: Fan Dance Rhythm (15s recast, does not lock Waltzes): grants strong physical and magical damage reduction that decays per hit down to a baseline floor; Dagger weapon skills restore mitigation and grant 1 Finishing Move.
mechanics: Dual-Dagger requirement: Both Main and Sub must hold Daggers for the full tank toolkit; swapping either slot disables key passive and reactive effects.

Fan Dance Rhythm: 15-second recast, up to 300-second duration, and does not lock out Waltzes. Starts with strong physical and magical damage reduction that decays with each eligible hit down to a baseline floor.
Fan Dance recovery: Eligible Dagger weapon skills restore lost Fan Dance mitigation up to its starting peak and grant an extra Finishing Move. Pirouette Deflect resets it immediately.
Steps & Cripple: Quickstep and Box Step cost 0 TP on a 5-second recast, generate 2 Finishing Moves and snap threat, and stack Cripple up to 3 stacks to weaken enemy offense and accuracy.
Dazzling Cadence: 25-second recast, 6-yalm single-target opener that generates heavy threat, inflicts a 2-second Stun, Blind, and Slow, and grants 3 Finishing Moves.
Aegis Waltz: Spending Finishing Moves on eligible Flourishes creates a short Stoneskin barrier scaling with the number of moves spent (up to 5 Finishing Moves), plus a qualifying self-cleanse.

souls.lore: A field-academy physician guided by luminous grimoires and a gentle fae companion, tending weary ranks with calm precision.
souls.summary: Light Arts Scholar healer: summons the faerie companion Eos, accelerates HP-free Sublimation charging, and grants free 10-yalm AoE coverage on qualifying Cure and Regen spells.
souls.atAGlance: Chirurgeon is a dedicated Scholar healer paired with the Light Arts faerie Eos. The Soul combines extended Light Arts and Addendum: White, wider Cure and Regen coverage, accelerated Sublimation MP storage without HP drain, and an autonomous companion that maintains stackable regeneration and cleanses ailments. Your role is steady, proactive healing while Eos handles triage; the faerie complements your casting rather than replacing it during dangerous boss bursts.
highlights: Unlocks Call Eos (300s recast), summoning a Light Arts faerie companion that maintains stackable Regen (I–V) and automatically casts -na spells and Erase.
Addendum: White lasts 2 hours.
Sublimation charges much faster with no HP drain.
Qualifying Cure and Regen spells gain free 10y AoE coverage without spending Stratagem charges.

weaponConfig.summary: Companion: Use Call Eos (300s recast) to summon your faerie wherever pet summoning is permitted and no other pet is active.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Companion: Use Call Eos (300s recast) to summon your faerie wherever pet summoning is permitted and no other pet is active.
souls.resourceSystem: Unlocks Call Eos (300s recast), summoning a Light Arts faerie companion that maintains stackable Regen (I–V) and automatically casts -na spells and Erase.
mechanics: Call Eos: Unlocks at Lv. 10 on a 300-second recast. Summons a real faerie companion with its own HP and MP pools.
Eos Regen: Companion-cast Regen (I–V) uses a separate status effect that coexists with your normal Regen and scales in strength with spell rank and ally vitality.
Addendum: White: Extended to 2 hours, supporting uninterrupted access to white magic tools.
Sublimation: Charges significantly faster with no HP drain; once full, the stored MP reserve lasts up to 2 hours until released.
Free 10-yalm Accession: Qualifying Cure and Regen spells gain automatic 10-yalm party AoE coverage without consuming Stratagem charges.
Companion commands: Eos can be directed or dismissed with the available faerie commands as needed.

souls.lore: A learned elemental theorist accompanied by a fierce fae spirit, inscribing enduring arcane equations across protracted battles.
souls.summary: Dark Arts Scholar caster: summons the dark faerie companion Titania, maintains permanent Ebullience, empowers long-lasting Helix spells, and sharpens elemental nuking.
souls.atAGlance: Heliarch is a Scholar elemental damage Soul paired with the dark faerie Titania. Extended Dark Arts, Addendum: Black, and permanent Ebullience fuel sustained black magic pressure, while empowered, long-lasting Helix spells reward keeping an elemental DoT on your quarry. Titania contributes enfeebles, Drain/Aspir, and elemental nukes against your target, while you direct spell selection, Magic Bursts, and MP management.
highlights: Unlocks Call Titania (300s recast), summoning a Dark Arts faerie companion for enfeebling, Drain/Aspir, and elemental nuking.
Addendum: Black lasts 2 hours.
Permanent Ebullience remains active for black magic without spending Stratagems.
Helix spells deal substantially increased damage and last up to 2 hours.
Passively boosts Magic Attack and allows qualifying elemental spells to partially bypass target Magic Evasion.

weaponConfig.summary: Equipment: Equip a Staff or Club with Elemental Magic skill, INT, Magic Attack Bonus, Magic Accuracy, Magic Burst gear, and MP sustain. An Orphic Egg in the ammo slot helps support Titania's MP in longer encounters.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Equipment: Equip a Staff or Club with Elemental Magic skill, INT, Magic Attack Bonus, Magic Accuracy, Magic Burst gear, and MP sustain. An Orphic Egg in the ammo slot helps support Titania's MP in longer encounters.
souls.resourceSystem: Unlocks Call Titania (300s recast), summoning a Dark Arts faerie companion for enfeebling, Drain/Aspir, and elemental nuking.
mechanics: Addendum: Black: Extended to 2 hours, keeping your dark magic toolkit ready across long encounters.
Permanent Ebullience: Automatically maintained on qualifying black magic without consuming Stratagems.
Empowered Helix: Qualifying Helix spells deal substantially increased damage and can persist for up to 2 hours unless overwritten or cleared.
Elemental potency & penetration: Heliarch passively increases Magic Attack and partially bypasses enemy Magic Evasion on qualifying elemental spells.
Call Titania: Unlocks at Lv. 10 on a 300-second recast. Summons an independent dark faerie companion with its own HP and MP that tracks your magic target.
Companion sustain: Keep Titania safe and supplied with MP during extended caster fights.

souls.lore: A meticulous chronicler of monster lore who studies a foe’s signature habits and drafts tailored countermeasures on the parchment of battle.
souls.summary: Observe one enemy, record an exact hostile action, and file a targeted countermeasure to protect an ally when that same attack repeats.
souls.atAGlance: Archivist is a precision countermeasure support Soul. It observes a specific hostile spell or enemy technique, saves that exact action as a Record, and files a one-use Countermeasure on an ally expected to take that same attack next. Rather than blanket damage reduction, Archivist rewards learning recurring boss abilities and shielding the right teammate at the right moment.
highlights: Record (20y range, 6s recast) watches for 12 seconds and stores an exact enemy action for 60 seconds; holds 1 record slot at Lv. 10 and 2 from Lv. 50.
File Countermeasure (0 MP, 15s recast) shields one ally within 15y (20y at Lv. 30+) against the exact recorded action for 20 seconds (25 seconds at Lv. 70+).
Countermeasure protection strengthens as you level; when multiple pages match the same hit, only the strongest applies.
Index Pages (1s recast) unlocks at Lv. 50 to switch between two live records, while Margin Note (4 MP, 6s recast) provides single-target earth filler damage.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Staff and Club are the eligible weapon-skill families. The observation and filing loop functions cleanly with standard gear and any subjob.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Staff and Club are the eligible weapon-skill families. The observation and filing loop functions cleanly with standard gear and any subjob.
souls.resourceSystem: Record: 20-yalm range, 12-second observation window, 6-second recast. Saved records last 60 seconds and bind to the exact enemy, spawn, and action identity.
mechanics: Record: 20-yalm range, 12-second observation window, 6-second recast. Saved records last 60 seconds and bind to the exact enemy, spawn, and action identity.
Level progression:
Lv. 10: 1 record slot, 15-yalm filing range, 20-second page duration, and foundational countermeasure mitigation.
Lv. 30: Filing range expands to 20 yalms and countermeasure protection strengthens.
Lv. 50: Unlocks a 2nd record slot and Index Pages to switch between stored records.
Lv. 70+: Page duration extends to 25 seconds and countermeasure protection reaches its peak strength.

souls.lore: A geomantic wayfinder who traces luminous ley-corridors across the terrain, empowering allies who hold the sacred line.
souls.summary: Turn your own movement and a fixed anchor into a live corridor that grants physical Accuracy and Magic Accuracy to party members along the line.
souls.atAGlance: Meridian is a positional support Soul that turns your own movement into one endpoint of a live accuracy corridor. By placing a fixed meridian anchor and stepping a short distance away, you project a lane between the anchor and yourself that grants both physical Accuracy and Magic Accuracy to allies standing along it. Meridian shines when the party coordinates its formation so your corridor covers multiple teammates at once.
highlights: Lv. 10: Cast Lay Meridian (0 MP, 18s recast) and step 3–15 yalms from your anchor to project a corridor granting physical Accuracy and Magic Accuracy.
Allies within 2 horizontal yalms of the line (expanding to 2.5 yalms at Lv. 50) and within 3 vertical yalms receive the accuracy bonus.
Lv. 30: Unlocks Meridian Shift (20s recast) to relocate your anchor without extending duration; accuracy bonuses grow steadily with level.
Lv. 70+: Corridor duration extends from 30 to 40 seconds; when multiple corridors overlap, only the strongest applies.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Club and Staff are the eligible weapon-skill and talent families. Your meridian corridor works cleanly without specialized subjob or weapon-skill talent requirements.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Club and Staff are the eligible weapon-skill and talent families. Your meridian corridor works cleanly without specialized subjob or weapon-skill talent requirements.
souls.resourceSystem: Lv. 10: Cast Lay Meridian (0 MP, 18s recast) and step 3–15 yalms from your anchor to project a corridor granting physical Accuracy and Magic Accuracy.
mechanics: Level progression:
Lv. 10: Establishes the accuracy corridor with a 2-yalm horizontal width and 30-second duration, granting scaling physical Accuracy and Magic Accuracy.
Lv. 30: Unlocks Meridian Shift and strengthens the Accuracy and Magic Accuracy bonuses.
Lv. 50: Corridor width expands to 2.5 yalms horizontally and accuracy bonuses grow further.
Lv. 70+: Corridor duration extends to 40 seconds and accuracy bonuses reach their peak strength.

Corridor geometry: You must stand 3–15 horizontal yalms from the anchor, with no more than 3 vertical yalms of elevation difference between endpoints, and each ally must be within 3 vertical yalms of the line.

souls.lore: A gentle steward of living ley-lines who plants blooming luopan sanctuaries where weary travelers gather to be made whole.
souls.summary: Sylvan Luopan Sanctuary healer (Lv. 10+): pulses 3-second Verdant Bloom heals, MP recovery, and Barkskin barriers from your Luopan while triggering Nature's Surge on Cure, Indi, Geo, and Club/Staff weapon skills.
souls.atAGlance: Verdant is a Luopan-centered Geomancer healer built around a living sanctuary of earth pulses and reactive renewal. Your active Luopan emits Verdant Bloom pulses every 3 seconds that heal nearby allies, restore MP, and turn excess healing into protective Barkskin barriers. Casting Indicolure, Geocolure, or Cure spells—or landing Club and Staff weapon skills—triggers Nature's Surge to restore Luopan HP and pulse party healing with a cleanse. Canopy of the Ancients, Verdant Renewal, and an enhanced Life Cycle carry the group through heavy spikes, trading personal DPS for deep party sustain.
highlights: Passives grow with level, strengthening Max HP, Max MP, MND, VIT, Cure and Geomancy Potency, Fast Cast, Refresh, reduced Enmity, and slower Luopan HP drain.
Living Luopan Sanctuary: your Luopan pulses Verdant Bloom every 3s (15y), healing nearby allies, restoring MP, and converting overhealing into capped Barkskin Stoneskin barriers.
Sylvan Resonance: qualifying Cure, Indi, or Geo spells and Club/Staff weapon skills restore your Luopan to full HP and trigger Nature's Surge (party heal and 1-debuff cleanse).
Enhanced Geomancer JAs: Life Cycle (15s recast) fully restores your Luopan and heals the party with no self-HP loss, and Bolster greatly amplifies Verdant Bloom.

Verdant Renewal (20s recast, 15y AoE) delivers a major party heal, 3-debuff cleanse, and 15s of Regen and Refresh; Canopy of the Ancients (25s recast, 12s, 15y AoE) grants party damage reduction, Knockback Immunity, and bonus AoE heals on qualifying spells and weapon skills.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Equip a Club with Shield or a Staff, paired with a Handbell. Eligible Club and Staff weapon skills trigger Sylvan Resonance for extra group healing.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Equip a Club with Shield or a Staff, paired with a Handbell. Eligible Club and Staff weapon skills trigger Sylvan Resonance for extra group healing.
souls.resourceSystem: Passives grow with level, strengthening Max HP, Max MP, MND, VIT, Cure and Geomancy Potency, Fast Cast, Refresh, reduced Enmity, and slower Luopan HP drain.
mechanics: Verdant Bloom: Pulses every 3 seconds from your active Luopan (15-yalm radius), healing nearby allies, restoring MP, and converting overhealing into a capped Barkskin Stoneskin barrier. Healing potency grows as you level.
Bolster synergy: Substantially amplifies Verdant Bloom's healing output while active.

Sylvan Resonance & Nature's Surge: Qualifying Cure, Indi, or Geo spells and Club/Staff weapon skills restore your Luopan to full HP and trigger Nature's Surge for a party-wide heal and 1-debuff cleanse.

Canopy of the Ancients: 25-second recast, 12-second duration (15-yalm Party AoE). Grants damage reduction, Knockback Immunity, and bonus AoE healing whenever you cast qualifying spells or land weapon skills.
Verdant Renewal: 20-second recast (15-yalm Party AoE). Delivers a major instant party heal, cleanses up to 3 debuffs, and applies 15 seconds of Regen and Refresh.
Enhanced Life Cycle: 15-second recast. Fully restores Luopan HP and pulses a strong party heal without draining your own HP.

souls.lore: A seismic mystic who listens to the deep pulse beneath the crust, calling forth sudden earthen upheavals along shifting fault lines.
souls.summary: Predict where a claimed quarry will stand and erupt a delayed single-target earthen fault directly beneath it.
souls.atAGlance: Seismancer is a predictive single-target earth damage Soul built around reading where your claimed quarry will stand. You arm a delayed earthen fault beneath a target, keep it inside the marked zone until the fuse finishes, and weave Stone Chip between eruptions. Positioning and claim discipline determine whether your MP converts into heavy damage: once armed, a fault spends its MP and starts its recast even if the quarry escapes. Seismancer is strictly single-target—each fault can strike only its original claimed quarry.
highlights: Lv. 10: Stone Chip (3 MP, 4s recast) establishes claim; Shallow Fault (18y range) erupts after a 2-second fuse. Lv. 30: Deep Fault erupts after a 4-second fuse for much heavier earth damage.
Each fault strikes only the original claimed enemy and spawn if it remains within 3 horizontal yalms and 3 vertical yalms of the marked spot.
Both faults share an 8-second recast and spend a max-MP-proportional cost; invalid placement costs nothing, while a successfully armed fault commits its cost even if the quarry escapes.

weaponConfig.summary: Weapons: Club and Staff are the eligible weapon-skill and talent families. The fault rotation functions cleanly without weapon-skill talent investment.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Weapons: Club and Staff are the eligible weapon-skill and talent families. The fault rotation functions cleanly without weapon-skill talent investment.
souls.resourceSystem: Lv. 10: Stone Chip (3 MP, 4s recast) establishes claim; Shallow Fault (18y range) erupts after a 2-second fuse. Lv. 30: Deep Fault erupts after a 4-second fuse for much heavier earth damage.
mechanics: One quarry, one fault: An armed fault binds exclusively to the original enemy and spawn; it never transfers to another mob, a new target, or a later respawn.
Shallow Fault (Lv. 10+): 18-yalm placement range, 2-second fuse, 8-second shared recast, and a moderate max-MP-proportional cost. Reliable earth damage that strengthens as you level up.

Deep Fault (Lv. 30+): 18-yalm placement range, 4-second fuse, 8-second shared recast, and a higher max-MP-proportional cost. Delivers substantially stronger single-target earth damage that grows further at higher levels.
Invalid placement safety: Attempting an invalid placement costs nothing, whereas a successfully armed fault commits its MP cost and shared recast even if the quarry moves out of the 3-yalm zone.
Soul HUD: Tracks the armed fault type, remaining fuse timer, original quarry, whether the quarry is still inside the mark, and the shared recast.
Invalidation: Pending faults cancel automatically on death, zoning, Soul change, or loss of claim.

souls.lore: A greatsword-wielding conduit who etches glowing runes along steel, unleashing conducted elemental brilliance in decisive strokes.
souls.summary: Elemental Great Sword spellweaver (Lv. 10+): weave enchanted Rune Edge strikes, Effusion Slash, and Overcharge Runes to build Conduction (up to 3 stacks) and MP for prepared Runic Bolt and Runic Sever casts that ignite Edgeflare.
souls.atAGlance: Spellblade is a Great Sword elemental spellweaver built around the rhythm of enchanted swings, Conduction stacks, and prepared arcane casting. Your active Rune sets the element of Rune Edge, while Great Sword strikes and Effusion Slash build Conduction to make Runic Bolt and Runic Sever faster, cheaper, and stronger. Landing those arcane finishers triggers Edgeflare to empower your next wave of enchanted swings. Unlike traditional tank-oriented Rune Fencers, Spellblade is tuned for aggressive hybrid damage and Magic Burst windows.
highlights: High Great Sword, Elemental Magic, and Enhancing Magic proficiency with growing Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Accuracy; one Rune cast fills all unlocked slots (1 early, 2 at Lv. 35, 3 at Lv. 65).
Rune Edge: your first landed normal Great Sword hit each round deals scaling elemental damage (amplified during Overcharge Runes), restores MP, and builds Conduction (max 3).
Effusion Slash (Lv. 10, 20s recast, Enemy 4y): non-consuming Great Sword arcane strike aligned to your newest Rune that can Magic Burst, builds Conduction, and restores TP.
Overcharge Runes (Lv. 10, 30s recast, Self 12s): arcane overdrive boosting Magic Attack, Attack, Magic Burst damage, and Rune Edge potency while refreshing active Rune durations.

Runic Bolt (Lv. 10, 2s base cast, 8s recast, 8–24 MP, 10y) & Runic Sever (Lv. 55, 3s base cast, 30s recast, 40 MP, 10y): arcane spells scaling with skills, weapon damage, INT, STR, active Runes, and Conduction (each stack cuts cast time and MP cost while boosting damage).
Edgeflare (Lv. 30+): positive damage from Runic Bolt, Runic Sever, or Effusion Slash empowers Rune Edge for 12s; supported by Swordplay, Vallation, Gambit, and Runic Ascendance (2-hour).

weaponConfig.summary: Required weapon: Main-hand a Great Sword. Swapping Main or Sub weapons clears your Conduction stacks and interrupts your spellweaving setup.

souls.equipmentCompatibility: Required weapon: Main-hand a Great Sword. Swapping Main or Sub weapons clears your Conduction stacks and interrupts your spellweaving setup.
souls.resourceSystem: High Great Sword, Elemental Magic, and Enhancing Magic proficiency with growing Magic Attack Bonus and Magic Accuracy; one Rune cast fills all unlocked slots (1 early, 2 at Lv. 35, 3 at Lv. 65).
mechanics: Conduction: Stacks up to 3; generated at 1 stack per qualifying landed Great Sword round (2 during Runic Ascendance) and by Effusion Slash.
Runic Bolt: Unlocks at Lv. 10 (2-second base cast, 8-second recast, 8–24 MP by level, 10-yalm range). Scales with Elemental Magic skill, weapon damage, INT, STR, active Runes, and spent Conduction.
Runic Sever: Unlocks at Lv. 55 (3-second base cast, 30-second recast, 40 MP, 10-yalm range). Heavy arcane finisher with strong Magic Burst synergy.
Conduction spending: Each spent stack trims cast time, reduces MP cost, and boosts the damage of Runic Bolt and Runic Sever.

Rune Edge: Bonus elemental damage and MP recovery on your first landed Great Sword hit per round, scaling with weapon delay, Great Sword and Enhancing skills, and active Runes—greatly amplified during Overcharge Runes.
Effusion Slash: Lv. 10 (20-second recast, 4-yalm range). Non-consuming Great Sword arcane strike aligned to your newest Rune that can Magic Burst and grants scaling TP.

souls.lore: A frontline rune-mender who braids living sigils into restorative pulses, renewing embattled allies amid the clash of arms.
souls.summary: Keeper of Sacred Yggdrasil Runes (Lv. 10+): transforms Vivacious Pulse into a 15s Party AoE heal with Rune-driven Regen, Cleanse, Refresh, or Stoneskin boons, while projecting Regen spells across nearby allies.
souls.atAGlance: Lifebinder is a frontline Rune Fencer healer whose party support adapts to the three Runes you hold. Runic Lifetap turns melee hits and weapon skills into automatic healing for injured allies, Regen spells project across nearby party members, and Sacred Pulse (Vivacious Pulse) converts your active Runes into boosted healing, cleanses, MP/Refresh, or Stoneskin barriers. Mastering Lifebinder means choosing the right three-Rune loadout for each boss phase while keeping steady melee uptime.
highlights: Passives grow with level, strengthening Max MP, Refresh, MND, VIT, Cure Potency, Enhancing/Divine/Healing Magic skills, Fast Cast, and reduced Enmity.

Sacred Pulse (Vivacious Pulse at Lv. 10, 15s recast, Party 12y AoE): restores party HP and adds per-Rune boons—Lux boosts healing and applies Regen, Unda cleanses debuffs, Tenebrae restores MP and grants Refresh, and elemental Runes grant Stoneskin.
Font of Life (Lv. 10, 20s recast, Ally 15y): delivers a major single-target heal, cleanses up to 2 status ailments, and grants 12s of damage reduction and bonus Cure Potency Received.
Sanctified Ward (Lv. 10, 35s recast, Party 12y AoE): instant party heal followed by a 15s Sanctuary granting Regen, damage reduction, and Magic Evasion.
Runic Lifetap: melee hits and weapon skills while holding Runes mend the most injured party member within 12y and restore caster MP.

Projected Regen & Wards: Regen I–IV project as enhanced 10y Party AoE spells with extended duration; One for All (60s recast) adds a party heal and Valiance (60s recast) grants bonus Cure Potency Received and Fast Cast.

souls.lore: A stern sentinel of the Sacred City’s arcane traditions who shifts effortlessly between honed swordplay and shimmering runic wards.
souls.summary: Order of Conscience ward tank (Lv. 10+): holds 3 Runes at Lv. 10+, preserves Runes on Swipe, Lunge, Gambit, and Rayke, ripostes on Parry, and pivots between short-recast Physical Parry and Elemental Aegis stances.
souls.atAGlance: Runeweft is a stance-swapping Rune Fencer ward tank that pivots smoothly between physical parry mastery and elemental magic defense. Stance: Iron Battuta fortifies Parry and physical mitigation, while Stance: Runic Aegis counters magical and breath assaults with Magic Evasion, Magic Defense, and self-recovery. Swapping stances refreshes your Runes and pulses threat, Runic Riposte turns every Parry into an elemental counter-slash with self-sustain, and Runic Convergence briefly fuses both stances for mixed-damage emergencies.
highlights: Passives grow with level, strengthening Max HP, VIT, AGI, damage mitigation, Enmity, and threat retention.

Parry & Runic Persistence: Great Sword and Parrying skills plus Parry Rate (extra with Great Sword) grow with level; holds 3 Runes at Lv. 10+ and preserves Runes on Swipe, Lunge, Gambit, and Rayke while adding Enmity.
Runic Riposte: parrying restores HP, MP, and TP, generates Enmity, and strikes back with an elemental counter-slash.
Stance: Iron Battuta (Lv. 10, 15s shared recast): boosts Parry Rate, physical mitigation, and Defense; swapping in triggers Steel Flash (AoE Enmity, Stoneskin, and Rune refresh).

Stance: Runic Aegis (Lv. 10, 15s shared recast): boosts magical/breath mitigation, Magic Evasion, Magic Defense, and Magic Absorb; swapping in triggers Odyllic Pulse (Enmity, HP/MP recovery, cleanse, and Rune refresh).
Runic Convergence (Lv. 10, 30s recast, 10s): requires at least 1 active Rune; fuses both stances for combined mitigation, Parry, Magic Evasion, and Enmity while restoring HP per active Rune.

Tank Tradeoff & JAs: trades lower personal Attack and Weapon Skill damage for enhanced Vallation, Valiance, Swordplay (starts at max stacks with bonus Enmity), Pflug (adds physical mitigation), Battuta, and Liement.
